title: Senior Developer - ServiceNow Now Assist & CSM
description:
**Job Title**

**Senior Developer – ServiceNow Now Assist & CSM**

**Role / Job Summary**

In our experience, we look for a Senior ServiceNow Developer with strong, hands-on expertise in Customer Service Management (CSM) and experience implementing Now Assist capabilities. The role involves designing, building, and enhancing CSM solutions that support customer support operations, along with configuring AI-led Now Assist experiences across case management and agent workflows.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and configure scalable ServiceNow Customer Service Management (CSM) solutions to support customer support operations and digital service transformation.
* Gather and analyze business requirements from customer service, operations, and support teams, and translate them into technical design specifications and development tasks.
* Develop and customize Case Management, Agent Workspace, Service Portal / Customer Portal, Playbooks, Knowledge Management, and SLA workflows.
* Build and enhance Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Flow Designer flows, and Notifications.
* Develop integrations with third-party applications such as CRM, ERP, monitoring tools, and external customer systems using REST APIs, SOAP, IntegrationHub, and MID Server.
* Customize and enhance the Customer Portal using Service Portal widgets and custom components.
* Implement data imports, transform maps, and CSM-specific data models.
* Customize the Case Management lifecycle, including assignment rules, playbooks, routing, and Agent Workspace configuration.
* Configure and implement Now Assist capabilities within CSM workflows to support AI-led case handling and agent productivity.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and cross-functional teams to understand design dependencies and ensure smooth solution delivery.
* Support testing lifecycle activities, including SIT, UAT, defect fixing, production deployment, and post-go-live support.
* Perform platform upgrades, enhancements, troubleshooting, and optimization to improve system performance and user experience.

**Must-Have Skills**

* 5–8 years of experience in ServiceNow development, with strong expertise in Customer Service Management (CSM).
* Hands-on implementation experience with Now Assist for CSM.
* Strong experience across the following ServiceNow CSM modules:
  + Case Management
  + Account & Contact Management
  + Consumer Service Portal
  + Agent Workspace
  + Knowledge Base
  + Entitlements & SLAs
  + Playbooks
  + Omnichannel customer workflows
* Strong proficiency in JavaScript, Glide APIs, GlideRecord, GlideAjax, Script Includes, Business Rules, and Client Scripts.
* Hands-on experience with Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, and Service Portal / custom widgets.
* Good understanding of customer service processes, ticket lifecycle, case routing, escalation, and SLA management.
* Education: Undergraduate degree and above.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Exposure to Now Assist capabilities beyond CSM, such as ITSM or HRSD generative AI use cases.
* Experience with Omnichannel configuration for chat, email, or virtual agent-based customer interactions.
* Familiarity with Performance Analytics and reporting on CSM case and SLA metrics.
* Prior experience working in a managed services or client-facing delivery environment.

**Experience Required**

5–8 Years

**Any Other Important Notes**

* Client-facing role requiring clear communication of technical design choices to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Involves participation in SIT, UAT, and post-go-live support cycles, which may require flexibility around release windows.
* Preferred certifications: CSA (Certified System Administrator), CAD (Certified Application Developer), CIS-CSM (Certified Implementation Specialist – Customer Service Management).
* Location: as per project / practice staffing requirement.

title: State Manager - FM (MH West)
description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

As the State Manager - Farm Machinery (MH West) at Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd within the Farm Division, you will hold a pivotal role in driving the success of our distributor network and overall FM sales performance. Your key responsibilities will include:

* Strategically identifying and selecting optimal locations to establish distributor outlets, based on an in-depth analysis of competitor activities and emerging market opportunities, to facilitate market expansion and penetration.
* Ensuring the achievement and maintenance of predefined revenue targets from the distributor channel on an annual basis, aligning with broader business objectives.
* Gaining a comprehensive understanding of distributor needs and challenges; developing innovative sales incentive programs and promotional campaigns that effectively motivate distributors to increase sales volumes.
* Conducting thorough evaluation of diverse markets to tailor sales promotion activities aimed at boosting visibility and market share for specific products.
* Fostering strong, long-term, and mutually beneficial relationships with high-volume distributors, serving as a trusted advisor and partner.
* Providing leadership and actionable guidance to distributors to assist in their efforts to expand retail networks, thereby enhancing market coverage and customer accessibility.
* Analyzing distributor cash-flow dynamics and implementing optimized delivery and collections schemes to support financial stability and operational efficiency.
* Driving supplier performance improvements through effective supplier consequence management strategies, facilitating a robust supply ecosystem.
* Collaborating closely with Zonal and State teams to synergize efforts in boosting business growth through distributor channels, ensuring alignment on objectives and execution plans.
* Implementing a structured review mechanism to monitor and assess distributor volume performance on a weekly and monthly cadence, enabling timely course corrections and support.
* Understanding government-related business processes and liaising with state teams to unlock new business opportunities within the public sector, guiding distributors on leveraging these channels.
* Coordinating with manufacturing and supply chain departments to assure the availability of the right products at the right time by establishing reliable and accurate forecasting methodologies.
* Establishing and maintaining dealership-level processes covering enquiry management, retail operations, and performance tracking through a dealer management system, ensuring operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

In this role, you will be expected to demonstrate strong leadership, strategic thinking, and excellent communication skills as you collaborate with diverse internal and external stakeholders to achieve business goals and continuously enhance the distributor network’s performance.

**Preferred Industries**
------------------------

**Marketing & Comm**

**Education Qualification**
---------------------------

B.E/B.Tech - Agricultural Engineering

**General Experience**
----------------------

The prospective candidate should bring substantial experience in the sales and distribution sector, including:

* A robust track record spanning between 12 to 15 years in sales management, channel development, and distributor relationship management, preferably within industries related to agricultural machinery, farming solutions, or industrial equipment.
* Demonstrated success in managing large sales territories, focusing on revenue growth and market expansion through distributor channels, showcasing an ability to navigate competitive and diverse market landscapes.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams such as manufacturing, supply chain, and marketing to synchronize efforts and optimize product availability and promotional activities.
* Proven competency in leading teams and mentoring distributor partners, with a focus on building sustainable business relationships and enhancing partner capabilities.
* Familiarity with government sector business practices and liaising with state or regional teams to unlock government contracts and opportunities is highly desirable.
* Solid understanding of distributor business financial operations, including cash flow management, credit control, and collections methodology.
* Adeptness at applying data-driven decision-making and engaging in strategic foresight to anticipate market trends and adjust sales strategies proactively.

**Critical Experience**
-----------------------

The role requires critical experience and competencies that underpin effective leadership and business execution, including but not limited to:

* Deep expertise in dealer management and channel profitability, with a history of successfully designing and implementing distributor selection, evaluation, onboarding, and performance review processes.
* Strong capabilities in market analysis, including benchmarking and trend analysis, to accurately assess competition and identify new market opportunities for strategic expansion.
* Advanced skills in sales planning, revenue management, and forecasting, critical to ensuring product availability and meeting sales targets through robust distribution networks.
* Proven ability to build and nurture sustainable distributor relationships by understanding and addressing their latent needs through tailored sales schemes and motivation programs.
* Competency in managing supplier relationships and improving supplier performance via consequence management strategies, ensuring seamless supply chain operations.
* Experience in liaising with governmental bodies and managing government business pipelines, enabling distributors to participate effectively in this sector.
* Demonstrated strategic business orientation encompassing anticipation and leveraging of business opportunities, strategic foresight, and a global mindset aligned with sustainable leadership principles.
* Leadership qualities encompassing stakeholder focus, frugal and sustainable approaches, fostering innovation, change management, and risk-taking with accountability.
* A strong customer focus, including sensitivity and commitment to customer delight, serving orientation, and building long-term customer relationships.
* Excellent project management skills, underpinned by passion for quality, agility, discipline, and accountability for results.
* Human capital leveraging competencies such as team development, appreciation of diversity, entrepreneurial engagement, and cultivating synergistic team environments.
* Attributes reflecting passion for work, barrier-free collaboration, infusing enjoyment into work, and a positive approach to learning from setbacks.

Bringing together these experiences and competencies will enable the successful candidate to lead the distributor network effectively while aligning with the core values and strategic objectives of Mahindra & Mahindra's Farm Division.

title: Technical Support Advisory
description:
**Overview**

Microsoft Customer and Partner Solutions-Core (MCAPS) accelerates customer outcomes and business growth. By uniting product, engineering, marketing, sales, customer success, and partners around a common customer mission, we help customers realize value faster and turn innovation into measurable business impact. Through deep technical expertise and differentiated go-to-market execution, we win competitively, capture market share, and scale repeatable growth motions. We differentiate through value creation - delivering world-class, AI-powered customer experiences that accelerate adoption, strengthen loyalty, and create sustainable competitive advantage, driving growth that outpaces the market.

Within MCAPS - Core, the Customer Service & Support (CSS) organization builds trust and confidence for every person and organization through delivering a seamless support experience. In CSS, we are powered by Microsoft’s AI technology to help consumers, businesses, partners, and more, resolve their issues quickly and securely, helping prevent future problems from occurring and achieving more from their Microsoft investment.

We are looking for an individual who is a service delivery focused subject matter expert. You will be responsible for frontline engineer or delivery partner support staff technical readiness and process compliance. You will provide in-depth technical & subject matter expertise for one or more products, services, or scenarios all while driving delivery excellence in a collaborative environment to achieve superior customer outcomes. Your primary accountability is to the support staff and managers on the teams you work with. This opportunity enables and promotes career growth as a recognized technical SME.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

* Team Readiness & Development: You will ensure timely case resolution by driving engineer readiness based on skills-gap analysis and product needs.

* Managing Collaborative Activities: Mentor engineers to be more effective collaborators (cross-team and cross-technologies/lines of business).
* Supportability Activities: You will contribute to customer self-help and volume deflection initiatives through activities like input on top pain areas and producing troubleshooting guides/readiness content to help with volume deflection.
* Process Improvement: Collaborate with stakeholder teams to provide product and process improvement feedback.

 **Qualifications**

Required Qualifications:  
Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology (IT), Computer Science, Business Administration, Electrical Engineering, or Business Leadership AND 3+ years system development, network operations, software support, IT, consulting or technical troubleshooting experience  
OR equivalent experience  
3+ years of prior product, customer support and/or technical support experience with Networking Storage and High availability

Language Qualification  
English Language: fluent in reading, writing and speaking.

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and / or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings: Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire / transfer and every two years thereafter.

  
  

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. title: Senior Modern Workplace Engineer
description:
**About Onit**

We're redefining the future of legal operations through the power of AI. Our cutting-edge platform streamlines enterprise legal management, matter management, spend management and contract lifecycle processes, transforming manual workflows into intelligent, automated solutions.

We’re a team of innovators using **AI at the core** to help legal departments become faster, smarter, and more strategic. As we continue to grow and expand the capabilities of our new AI-centric platform, we’re looking for bold thinkers and builders who are excited to shape the next chapter of legal tech.

If you're energized by meaningful work, love solving complex problems, and want to help modernize how legal teams operate, we’d love to meet you.

**Position Summary**

This is a hands-on Senior Modern workplace engineer role focused on modern endpoint engineering, device identity, security, automation and lifecycle management. The role will own and evolve Microsoft's modern workplace stack with Microsoft Intune and Windows Autopilot at its core, integrated with Microsoft Entra ID, Conditional Access, endpoint security, application deployment and patching. The successful candidate should be strong enough to solve complex L3 issues independently, but broad enough to understand how endpoint, identity, security and user experience work together.

**Onit's technology environment changes quickly. The successful candidate will be evaluated not only on what they already know, but on how effectively they learn, apply and operationalize new capabilities.**

### **What This Role Is Expected to Deliver**

* Build a secure, scalable and low-touch endpoint platform for Windows devices, with increasing capability across macOS.
* Reduce manual administration through PowerShell, Microsoft Graph and proactive remediation/automation.
* Improve device compliance, deployment quality, patch posture and endpoint security without creating unnecessary friction for users.
* Own endpoint-related projects from design and pilot through production rollout, documentation, change communication and operational handover.
* EPM, SAAS Management, Shadow IT/AI and AI Governance are key projects in Pipeline.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, deploy and administer Microsoft Intune for device compliance, configuration profiles, security baselines, enrollment, application deployment and update management.
* Own Windows Autopilot end to end, including device registration, hardware hashes, deployment profiles, Enrollment Status Page (ESP), user-driven and pre-provisioned scenarios, troubleshooting and lifecycle operations.
* Design and maintain Conditional Access controls tied to compliant/corporate devices, MFA and Zero Trust access principles in partnership with security and identity stakeholders.
* Manage the endpoint-related Microsoft Entra ID surface, including device identity, registration, join states, authentication dependencies and access troubleshooting.
* Package, test and deploy Win32, Microsoft Store and line-of-business applications, including detection rules, dependencies, install/uninstall logic and remediation of failed deployments.
* Build PowerShell and Microsoft Graph automation for reporting, compliance, device operations, configuration validation and repetitive administration.
* Create and maintain proactive remediation/detection-remediation logic to address configuration drift, device health and recurring endpoint issues before they become tickets.
* Own Windows patch/update strategy using Windows Update for Business, update rings and related Microsoft capabilities; support application patching and verification processes.
* Implement and improve endpoint security controls including BitLocker, LAPS, attack-surface reduction/security baselines and integration with enterprise security tooling such as CrowdStrike or Microsoft Defender concepts.
* Support and progressively deepen macOS management capability using Jamf Pro/Apple Business Manager, ADE, FileVault and macOS compliance where applicable.
* Act as the L3 escalation point for complex enrollment failures, policy conflicts, Autopilot provisioning issues, application deployment failures and device compliance problems.
* Work across Microsoft 365 services such as OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams and Exchange Online where endpoint or identity policies intersect with the user experience.
* Evaluate new Microsoft/Apple endpoint capabilities, and recommend production adoption when they improve security, supportability or user experience.
* Create technical documentation, SOPs and runbooks; mentor other IT team members and transfer knowledge rather than becoming a single point of dependency.

### **Required Skills - Must Have**

* Strong hands-on Microsoft Intune administration in an enterprise environment.
* Strong Windows Autopilot implementation and troubleshooting experience.
* Strong understanding of compliance policies, configuration profiles, security baselines and device lifecycle management.
* Hands-on application packaging/deployment using Win32 (.intunewin) or equivalent enterprise packaging methods, including detection and dependency logic.
* Hands-on Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access experience, especially device-based access and compliance scenarios.
* Strong L3 troubleshooting ability across enrollment, policy, application deployment, authentication and compliance issues.
* Strong PowerShell scripting skills for automation and troubleshooting.
* Practical endpoint security knowledge including disk encryption, endpoint hardening, patching and least-privilege concepts.
* Ability to independently plan and execute technical changes/projects with pilots, rollback thinking, stakeholder communication and post-change validation.
* PIM, SSO concepts (SAML/OIDC), enterprise application registration and broader Entra identity administration.
* Jamf Pro, Apple Business Manager/ADE, FileVault and macOS administration.

### **Adjacent Skills - Good to Have / Learn Quickly**

* Microsoft Graph API automation and reporting.
* BeyondTrust Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM), Microsoft EPM or similar least-privilege tooling.
* CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or comparable endpoint security platforms.
* Microsoft 365 migration or tenant-to-tenant migration experience.
* ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR or similar control/compliance environments.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* Takes independent ownership of the Intune/Autopilot/Entra endpoint stack and becomes the escalation point for complex endpoint problems.
* Automates recurring endpoint work and reduces avoidable manual administration/tickets.
* Improves compliance, patching and endpoint security posture while keeping user experience practical.
* Builds working knowledge in adjacent areas such as Jamf/macOS, EPM and broader identity rather than remaining an Intune-only specialist.
* Demonstrates learnability: can identify a knowledge gap, self-learn, test in a lab/pilot, apply the capability in production, document it and transfer the knowledge to others.

### **Experience & Qualifications**

* 8+ years relevant experience across enterprise IT, Microsoft 365, endpoint/security or related infrastructure disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience owning production systems and resolving complex technical problems, not only following predefined operational procedures.
* Experience working with distributed/global stakeholders and managing technical changes across business teams is preferred.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience in Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline.

### **Preferred Certifications**

* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102)
* Microsoft 365 Administrator / MS-102 or equivalent Microsoft 365 administration certification
* Microsoft Identity and Access Administrator (SC-300) - preferred
* Jamf certification - advantage, not mandatory

**Benefits & Perks That Support You:**

Onit offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support the whole employee at work and beyond:

Health Coverage: Employee and immediate family members.

Time Away: Flexible paid time off and 10 company paid holidays annually.

Family Support: ***Exceptional paid leave for birth parents, non-birth parents, and caregivers. Onit also offers surrogacy and adoption reimbursement.***

Income Protection: ***100% employer-paid life and disability insurance.***

Additional Coverage Options: Voluntary benefits including hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident***.***

Tax-Advantaged Accounts: ***Flexi, NPS***.

Community Engagement: One paid volunteer day each year to give back to the community.

**Our Commitment to Applicants**

We know that not everyone will check every box in a job description. At Onit, we value diversity, inclusion, and authenticity. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly who we’re looking for.

**Onit Values**

**Customer First -** Customer success is our success. We deliver value, listen, and act on customer needs.

**Purposeful Innovation -** Innovation fuels our growth. We harness creativity to solve problems and lead with the intentions and expertise.

**Win as One -** Teamwork is how we win. We are accountable, act with integrity, and communicate openly.

**Intentional Growth -** Our people are the difference. We create an environment with compelling work, impactful contributions, and career growth.

  

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Customer Success Executive
description:
**About the Role:**

We are looking for a customer-obsessed, strategic, and growth-oriented Customer Success Manager to own and scale post-sales customer relationships for Covoro. This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Account Management, and Business Development, with a strong focus on retention, expansion (cross-sell & upsell), and long-term value creation.

You will work closely with enterprise and mid-market customers' businesses, GST practitioners, CAs, and tax teams, helping them derive measurable value from Covoro’s GST and compliance technology suite while driving revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**● Customer Relationship Management:** Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, key stakeholders, and decision-makers to drive satisfaction, trust, and long-term retention.

● **Customer Onboarding & Adoption:** Work closely with customers during onboarding, implementation, training, and product adoption to ensure they derive maximum value from COVORO.

● **Customer Engagement:** Conduct regular customer check-ins, business reviews, feedback sessions, and follow-ups to understand customer needs and proactively address concerns.

● **Retention & Churn Prevention:** Monitor customer health, identify dissatisfaction or disengagement early, and develop action plans to improve retention and reduce churn.

● **Upselling & Cross-Selling:** Identify opportunities to expand existing accounts by recommending relevant COVORO features, modules, services, or solutions based on customer requirements.

● **Testimonials & Case Studies:** Proactively collect customer testimonials, success stories, reviews, and case studies that demonstrate COVORO’s business impact. Coordinate with customers to secure approvals for marketing and branding initiatives.

● **Customer Advocacy & Referrals:** Build a network of satisfied customers who can participate in references, referrals, webinars, events, and other marketing initiatives.

● **Issue Resolution & Coordination:** Act as the primary point of contact for customer concerns and coordinate with product, engineering, implementation, and support teams to ensure timely resolution.

● **Voice of Customer:** Gather customer feedback, identify recurring challenges, and communicate actionable insights to internal teams to improve the product and customer experience.

● **Account Growth & Revenue:** Own customer expansion opportunities, contribute to renewal and revenue targets, and maintain a healthy pipeline of upsell and cross-sell opportunities.

● **Customer Success Reporting:** Track customer satisfaction, adoption, retention, renewal status, expansion revenue, testimonials, and other relevant customer success metrics.

● **Customer Education:** Help customers understand new features, product updates, and relevant capabilities to improve adoption and strengthen their engagement with COVORO.

**What We’re Looking For**

● A strong people person who enjoys building relationships, interacting with customers, and earning their trust.

● Excellent communication, interpersonal, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

● Experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Client Relationship Management, or a similar customer-facing role.

● A customer-first mindset combined with a commercial approach to retention and account growth.

● Ability to identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities without compromising customer trust.

● Confidence in approaching customers for testimonials, referrals, case studies, and participation in marketing initiatives.

● Strong ownership and follow-through, with the ability to manage multiple customer relationships independently.

● Problem-solving skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.

● A proactive approach to identifying customer risks, improving adoption, and preventing churn.

● Experience with B2B SaaS, enterprise software, or technology products is preferred.

● Familiarity with e-invoicing, VAT, tax compliance, ERP integrations, or finance automation is an advantage.

**What You Will Not Get**

● A role limited to responding to customer complaints or managing support tickets.

● A passive account management position where customer engagement happens only when issues arise.

● A sales-only role focused on pushing products without understanding customer needs.

● Detailed instructions and follow-ups for every customer interaction.

● A role where customer feedback, retention, and account growth are someone else’s responsibility and assigned tasks.

**What You Will Get**

● Direct exposure to COVORO’s customers, product, and business growth strategy.

● Ownership of customer relationships from onboarding through adoption, retention, and expansion.

● Opportunities to influence product improvements through direct customer feedback.

● The ability to build customer advocacy through testimonials, case studies, referrals, and success stories.

● Hands-on experience across customer success, account growth, retention, and consultative selling.

● A role where relationship-building, initiative, and measurable business outcomes are valued.

title: Business IT Systems Analyst
description:
**Job Purpose:**  
The Business Analyst’s role is to elicit, analyze, specify, and validate the business needs of project stakeholders, be they customers or end-users. This includes interviewing stakeholders and gathering and compiling user requirements to create functional design specifications that can be used by development teams throughout the software lifecycle. In addition it is the responsibility of this role to plan, design, develop, and launch efficient business, financial, and operations systems in support of core organizational functions and business processes. This includes gathering and analyzing data in support of business cases, proposed projects, and systems requirements. The Business Analyst is also responsible for generating and compiling reports based on their findings, complete with probable causes and possible solutions to systems issues. This individual will apply proven communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills to help maximize the benefit of IT system investments. Moreover the Business Analyst will initiate the creation of test cases and lead business users through the testing of new solutions. Works with the QA and Training team to document system scenarios and identifies roles impacted
  
  
**Responsibilities:**  

* Collaborate with project managers and project sponsors to determine project scope.
* Clearly identify project stakeholders and establish user classes, as well as their characteristics.
* Conduct interviews and product analysis to gather user requirements via workshops, questionnaires, surveys, site visits, workflow storyboards, use cases, scenarios, and other methods.
* Meet with decision makers, systems owners, and end users to define business, financial, and operations requirements and systems goals, and identify and resolve systems issues.
* Develop and utilize standard templates to accurately and concisely write requirement specifications.
* Translate conceptual user requirements into functional requirements in a clear manner that is comprehensible to developers/project team.
* Where necessary, develop prototypes of interfaces and attributes based on findings. Lead design sessions in prototyping new systems for the purpose of enhancing business processes, operations, and information process flow
* Analyze and verify requirements for completeness, consistency, comprehensibility, feasibility, and conformity to standards.
* Identify and establish scope and parameters of requirements analysis in order to define impact, outcome criteria, and measure-taking actions.
* Work with stakeholders and project team to prioritize collected requirements.
* Create process models, specifications, diagrams, and charts to provide direction to developers and/or the project team.
* Manage and track the status of requirements throughout the project lifecycle; enforce and redefine as necessary.
* Communicate changes, enhancements, and modifications – verbally or through written documentation project managers, sponsors, and other stakeholders so that issues and solutions are understood.
* Review and analyze the effectiveness and efficiency of existing systems and develop strategies for improving or further leveraging these systems.
* Perform cost-benefit and return on investment analyses for proposed systems to aid management in making implementation decisions.
* Coordinate and perform in-depth tests, including end-user reviews, for modified and new systems, and other post-implementation support.
* Ensure compatibility and interoperability of in-house computing systems.
* Assist in conducting research on software and hardware products to justify recommendations and to support purchasing efforts.
* Provide orientation and training to end users for all modified and new systems
* Provide guidance and/or instruction to junior staff members.

Knowledge Skills and Experience
  
  

* College diploma or university degree in the field of business administration, computer science, finance, or information systems and 5 years related work experience.
* Proven experience in overseeing the design, development, and implementation of software and hardware solutions, systems, or products
* Ability to create systematic and consistent requirements specifications in both technical and user-friendly language.
* Ability to apply statistical and other research methods into systems issues and products as required.
* Demonstrated project management skills and project management software skills, including MS Project.
* Working technical knowledge of scripting languages, network and PC operating systems.
* Able to exercise independent judgement and take action on it.
* Excellent analytical, mathematical, and creative problem-solving skills.
* Excellent understanding of the organization’s goals and objectives.
* Excellent listening, interpersonal, written, and oral communication skills.
* Highly self motivated and directed.
* Ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks while under pressure.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment
* Excellent English language skills

description:

Summary:
  
The SAP Business AI Development Manager leads the design, engineering, and delivery of responsible, scalable AI solutions on SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP). The role combines hands-on SAP architecture and development expertise with engineering leadership, delivery governance, and stakeholder management. The manager will embed AI and generative AI capabilities into enterprise processes across SAP S/4HANA, SAP SuccessFactors, SAP Ariba, SAP Concur, supply chain, spend, and customer-experience solutions while maintaining clean-core, security, privacy, and responsible-AI standards.  
SAP BTP Development Manager  
  
SAP Business Technology Platform ,AI Engineering ,Generative AI ,Enterprise Application Development  
  
Role: SAP BTP & Business AI Development Manager, Architect  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  
Solution strategy and architecture: Define solution approaches and reference architectures for embedded and side-by-side AI extensions on SAP BTP, balancing business value, scalability, security, maintainability, and clean-core principles.  
Engineering leadership: Lead multidisciplinary teams of AI engineers, SAP BTP developers, data engineers, integration specialists, and quality engineers plan capacity, allocate work, remove delivery impediments, and coach team members.  
AI Foundation delivery: Govern development using SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, and the generative AI hub, covering experimentation, model selection, deployment, inference, monitoring, and continuous improvement.  
Generative AI adoption: Establish standards for prompt engineering, prompt lifecycle management, model evaluation, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, grounding, and rapid prototyping.  
Business-process integration: Embed capabilities such as intelligent document processing, natural-language interfaces, workflow automation, recommendations, forecasting, and decision support into SAP and non-SAP processes.  
Application development: Oversee SAP CAP, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, SAP HANA Cloud, Cloud Foundry, and Kyma-based development, including APIs, events, integrations, and reusable services.  
AI-assisted engineering: Guide responsible use of Joule for Developers and SAP Build Code for code scaffolding, explanation, refactoring, test generation, and review support.  
Quality and DevSecOps: Ensure AI-generated and developer-created artifacts are reviewed, validated, tested, secured, traceable, and approved before release drive CI/CD, observability, automated testing, and production-support practices.  
Responsible AI and governance: Implement controls for privacy, security, transparency, content safety, bias mitigation, human oversight, model risk, auditability, and regulatory compliance throughout the AI lifecycle.  
Capability building: Create engineering standards, reusable accelerators, reference implementations, and learning plans that strengthen AI, application development, integration, analytics, and data-engineering capabilities.  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  
Hands-on experience with SAP BTP and relevant services, including SAP AI Core, SAP AI Launchpad, the generative AI hub, SAP HANA Cloud, SAP Build Code, and SAP Integration Suite.  
Strong knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, embeddings, vector search, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and AI observability.  
Proficiency in one or more SAP development stacks: SAP CAP with Node.js or Java, ABAP Cloud, SAP Fiori/UI5, OData, REST APIs, and event-driven integration.  
Experience designing cloud-native applications and microservices on Cloud Foundry and,or Kyma,Kubernetes, supported by Git, CI,CD, automated testing, and secure DevOps practices.  
Good understanding of SAP BTP security, including identity and access management, OAuth, role-based access, secrets management, data protection, and secure API design.  
Working knowledge of AI-enabled business processes in SAP S/4HANA and one or more SAP cloud applications such as SuccessFactors, Ariba, Concur, Sales Cloud, or Signavio.  
Demonstrated ability to convert business opportunities into solution designs, delivery plans, estimates, risks, controls, and measurable outcomes.  
Strong people leadership, stakeholder management, communication, problem-solving, and delivery ownership.  
Preferred Qualifications  
SAP certification in BTP application development, integration, data, analytics, AI engineering, or a related specialization.  
Experience with SAP Joule Studio and the design or orchestration of AI agents.  
Experience with SAP Document AI, SAP Build Process Automation, Event Mesh, and asynchronous architectures.  
Knowledge of SAP HANA Cloud Predictive Analysis Library, Automated Predictive Library, and vector capabilities.  
Experience integrating models and services from Hyperscaler or SAP AI ecosystem partners through governed enterprise patterns.  
Experience delivering AI solutions in regulated environments with privacy, security, data residency, and compliance obligations.  
Familiarity with responsible-AI frameworks, model risk management, evaluation benchmarks, red teaming, and human-in-the-loop controls.  
Experience creating reusable assets, engineering playbooks, and communities of practice for enterprise AI adoption.  
Leadership Competencies  
Strategic orientation: Connect AI investments to business outcomes, adoption, and value realization.  
Technical judgment: Make pragmatic build, buy, reuse, and integration decisions across SAP and partner services.  
Delivery leadership: Manage scope, quality, schedule, cost, dependencies, and operational readiness across concurrent workstreams.  
Talent development: Build high-performing teams through coaching, feedback, knowledge sharing, and structured capability development.  
Executive communication: Explain complex AI concepts, design trade-offs, risks, and value in clear business language.  
Collaboration and ownership: Work effectively across business, architecture, engineering, data, security, legal, risk, and operations teams.  
Measures of Success  
AI use cases delivered on time, within agreed quality and risk thresholds, and with measurable business outcomes.  
Production reliability, security, performance, adoption, and responsible-AI compliance of deployed solutions.  
Reuse of approved architecture patterns, accelerators, components, and engineering standards.  
Improvement in engineering productivity, automated test coverage, release quality, and time to value.  
Stakeholder satisfaction and growth in the capability, proficiency, and retention of the engineering team.  
  
Additional Information:
  
Bachelor s or master s degree in computer science, engineering, data science, information systems, or a related discipline.  
Typically 10+ years of enterprise application or technology delivery experience, including 3+ years leading SAP BTP, AI/ML, data, or cloud engineering teams.

  
15 years full time education

description:

**WELCOME TO** **SITA**

At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.

title: Head - Technology & AI | E-Commerce | AI Agents | Engineering & Automations
description:
**The Opportunity**
-------------------

Ergode builds and scales digital-first businesses across global marketplaces.

We have made a clear strategic choice: **Technology, Artificial Intelligence and automation will sit at the core of how we scale revenue, improve margins and increase productivity.**

We are looking for a **hands-on Technology & AI leader** who can convert business problems into working, adopted systems — quickly.

This is not a traditional IT leadership role.

You will own the intersection of **business, engineering, AI, automation, data, integrations, infrastructure and security**. You will work directly with the CEO and business leaders to identify high-impact problems, decide what should be built internally versus externally, and ensure solutions move from idea production adoption measurable business outcome.

Some of our systems need modernization. Some need stronger ownership and architecture. Others need to be replaced or rebuilt. We would rather be transparent about that upfront.

We need someone who enjoys that challenge.

**What You Will Own**
=====================

**1. Technology Execution & Delivery**
--------------------------------------

You will create an execution culture where technology commitments translate into shipped outcomes.

You will:

* Run Technology on clear weekly priorities with an owner, deadline and measurable outcome for every major initiative.
* Establish strong engineering execution across product development, integrations, automation, infrastructure and AI.
* Track commitments through completion — not merely development activity.
* Identify blockers early and make fast build/buy/outsource decisions.
* Hold internal teams and external partners accountable for scope, timelines, quality and business outcomes.
* Build clear visibility from:

**Business Requirement**  **Development**  **Production**  **Adoption**  **Business Impact**

* Develop engineers and technology managers into stronger owners and future leaders.
* Create sufficient documentation, architecture standards and ownership so no critical system depends on one employee or vendor.

### **Success means:**

Leadership should never need to repeatedly ask, **“Where is this project stuck and who owns it?”**

**2. Business-First Technology Strategy**
=========================================

Technology exists to improve business outcomes.

You will:

* Deeply understand how Ergode makes money across marketplaces, brands and channels.
* Understand marketplace fees, margins, inventory, pricing, advertising, catalogue operations, fulfilment and customer experience.
* Own the Technology & AI roadmap based on impact on:
  + Revenue
  + Gross margin
  + Productivity
  + Operating cost
  + Speed
  + Customer/vendor experience
* Work directly with business heads to identify operational bottlenecks.
* Challenge processes that should be eliminated or simplified before automating them.
* Translate business problems into scalable technology solutions.
* Own technology economics including cloud, AI/token usage, software licences, development and outsourcing.
* Report technology performance to leadership in **business outcomes rather than project activity**.

**3. AI, Agents & Intelligent Automation**
==========================================

AI is not an innovation project at Ergode. It is becoming part of how the company operates.

You will:

* Identify high-volume and high-value manual work suitable for AI or automation.
* Build and deploy AI agents and GenAI workflows into **real production environments**.
* Develop reusable AI architecture rather than disconnected experiments.
* Integrate AI into areas including:
  + Catalogue and content
  + Marketplace listings
  + Pricing
  + Inventory
  + Customer support
  + Sales
  + Finance
  + HR
  + Reporting and decision support
* Build with LLM APIs, RAG, agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks and workflow automation.
* Establish before/after baselines for every major automation.
* Measure:
  + hours/FTE capacity saved
  + cycle-time reduction
  + cost reduction
  + quality improvement
  + revenue/margin impact
  + user adoption
* Kill pilots that do not produce value and scale the ones that do.
* Ensure business teams actually adopt what Technology builds.

### **We are not looking for:**

Someone who has attended AI courses or built demos.

### **We are looking for:**

Someone who has **put AI into production and can show what changed because of it.**

**4. E-commerce Platforms & Marketplace Technology**
====================================================

Our technology must support a complex global marketplace operation.

You will own and strengthen:

* Marketplace integrations including Amazon SP-API, Walmart, eBay and other channels.
* Catalogue and listing infrastructure.
* Pricing and quantity synchronization.
* Order processing.
* Inventory and warehouse integrations.
* Returns, refunds and reconciliation workflows.
* Marketplace reporting and operational intelligence.
* API reliability and monitoring.

You will build toward a connected architecture where catalogue, inventory, order and marketplace information flows reliably across systems.

The goal is not simply integration.

The goal is **reliable commerce at scale**.

**5. Product & Platform Ownership**
===================================

You will take ownership of Ergode’s core internal technology platforms and ensure they become dependable business systems.

This includes:

* evaluating existing architecture,
* identifying technical debt,
* establishing clear module ownership,
* improving reliability and usability,
* prioritising development based on business value,
* and driving adoption after launch.

Technology is not complete when code is deployed.

**A feature is complete when the business can reliably use it and the expected outcome is visible.**

**6. Data Foundation & Decision Intelligence**
==============================================

AI is only as strong as the underlying data.

You will:

* Build reliable data flows across business systems.
* Establish clear sources of truth for critical business information.
* Reduce duplicate datasets and manual reconciliation.
* Improve data quality and ownership.
* Enable dashboards and AI systems to consume trustworthy business data.
* Build APIs and integration layers that allow new agents and applications to be deployed quickly.

**7. Architecture, Cloud & Engineering Quality**
================================================

You should be technically strong enough to challenge architecture and engineering decisions yourself.

You will:

* Review architecture for scalability, reliability, maintainability, security and cost.
* Establish coding, testing, documentation and deployment standards.
* Strengthen CI/CD and monitoring.
* Review estimates rather than blindly accepting them.
* Prototype when speed requires it.
* Make pragmatic technology choices rather than over-engineering.

We expect a leader who can move comfortably between a **CEO conversation about ROI and an engineering conversation about architecture.**

**8. Security, Reliability & AI Governance**
============================================

You will own the reliability and security of Ergode’s technology environment.

Responsibilities include:

* Cloud and infrastructure reliability
* Monitoring and uptime
* Incident management
* Root-cause analysis
* Backups and disaster recovery
* Identity and access management
* SSO
* Endpoint/device security
* Data protection

You will also establish practical AI governance covering:

* which company information can be shared with which AI systems,
* permissions available to AI agents,
* human review requirements for critical decisions,
* auditability,
* and acceptable AI use.

Compliance should appropriately address DPDP and relevant international privacy/security requirements.

**9. Build vs Buy vs Outsource**
================================

We do not believe everything must be built internally.

We do believe **Ergode must own the outcome.**

You will decide when to:

**BUILD** — when capability creates strategic advantage.

**BUY** — when a reliable product already solves the problem economically.

**OUTSOURCE** — when an external specialist can deliver faster.

For outsourced work, you will own:

* requirements,
* architecture,
* vendor selection,
* commercial evaluation,
* milestones,
* SLAs,
* quality,
* security,
* source code,
* documentation,
* handover.

No critical Ergode technology should become permanently dependent on one vendor or individual.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

Within the first 6–12 months, we expect visible movement across these areas:

### **Execution**

* Major technology initiatives have clear owners, deadlines and outcomes.
* Delivery predictability improves materially.
* Chronic technology bottlenecks reduce.

### **AI & Automation**

* Multiple AI agents/workflows are operating in production.
* Automation impact is quantified monthly.
* Manual workload is measurably reduced in targeted processes.
* Business adoption is visible rather than assumed.

### **Core Platforms**

* Critical marketplace and internal systems become more reliable.
* Technical ownership and documentation improve.
* Important business workflows no longer depend on fragile manual processes.

### **Data**

* Critical catalogue, inventory, order and operational data become more connected and trustworthy.

### **Business Partnership**

* Business leaders increasingly bring problems to Technology because they expect **working solutions, not project discussions**.

**Who We Are Looking For**
==========================

**Must-Haves**
--------------

* 10+ years of meaningful technology experience.
* 5+ years leading engineering/technology teams.
* Evidence of personally owning major technology delivery.
* Strong understanding of software engineering, architecture, APIs and integrations.
* AI/automation systems deployed into production with measurable impact.
* Practical experience with:
  + LLM APIs
  + RAG
  + AI agents / agentic workflows
  + Python
  + workflow automation platforms such as n8n/Make or equivalent
* Cloud experience across AWS, Azure or GCP.
* API/integration architecture experience.
* DevOps, deployment and monitoring understanding.
* Ability to evaluate architecture, code/design decisions and engineering estimates.
* Experience managing external technology partners.
* Experience owning meaningful technology budgets.
* Strong business and commercial orientation.

**Strongly Preferred**
----------------------

Experience in one or more of:

* E-commerce
* Marketplaces
* Retail technology
* D2C
* SaaS/platform businesses
* ERP/OMS/WMS
* Amazon SP-API or other marketplace integrations
* High-volume order/catalogue/inventory systems
* AI-first enterprise transformation

**Who Will NOT Fit This Role**
==============================

This role is probably not for you if:

* Your experience is predominantly IT infrastructure/helpdesk.
* Your leadership style is primarily delegation without technical depth.
* Your AI experience consists mainly of courses, certifications or prototypes.
* You measure success by projects delivered rather than business outcomes achieved.
* You require large teams before you can execute.
* You prefer lengthy planning cycles over shipping, learning and improving.
* You cannot challenge engineers, vendors and business leaders when necessary.

**The Person Behind the Resume**
================================

We care about experience, but we care equally about how you operate.

We value people who demonstrate:

**Ownership. Bias for action. Curiosity. Commercial thinking. High standards. Candour. Learning velocity.**

We would rather hire a builder who has repeatedly solved difficult problems than someone with the perfect title.

title: Service Process Coach-West
description:
**Job Description**

Role Overview  
  
The After Sales Coach is responsible for driving dealership performance improvement through structured coaching, process assessment, and staff development across the after sales function. The role involves on-the-ground engagement with dealership teams to embed best practices, elevate customer satisfaction, and ensure consistent adherence to service processes and standards.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Coaching & Training**  
Coach customer-facing after sales staff (Service Advisors, CRM teams, Delivery personnel) on soft skills, complaint handling, communication, and empathy.  
  
Conduct live on-the-job (OJT) coaching sessions with real-time feedback and corrective guidance.  
  
Deliver structured training programs for non-technical dealership staff including workshops and one-on-one sessions.  
  
Support onboarding and induction of new dealership staff.  
  
**Process Implementation & Audits**  
  
Assess dealership after sales operations against defined SOPs and service standards.  
  
Conduct structured process audits and upload findings to relevant portals/systems.  
  
Perform gap analysis and develop actionable improvement plans aligned to dealership and OEM objectives.  
  
Implement best practice processes within dealerships and monitor compliance.  
  
**Customer Experience**  
  
Map and evaluate key customer journey touchpoints — from vehicle drop-off to post-service follow-up.  
Analyze CSI/NPS scores, VOC data, and customer complaint trends to identify service  
gaps.  
Drive experience enhancement initiatives — waiting lounge improvements,  
personalised service, customer engagement events.  
  
**Performance Management & Reporting**  
  
Monitor, evaluate, and report on dealership progress against KPIs (labour productivity,  
bay utilisation, service absorption, retention, repeat repairs, etc.).  
Prepare and submit detailed performance reports to regional managers and OEM  
stakeholders.  
Identify additional business opportunities within the dealership network.  
  
**Experience**  
  

* 10-15 years of experience in the automotive after sales domain.
* Min 5 years of prior experience in dealership coaching, consulting, or process

implementation roles preferred.  

* Background in workshop management, service head, or customer relations roles will be

an advantage.  

* Exposure to multi-brand dealership environments is desirable.

Skills & Competencies  

* Strong understanding of after sales workshop operations — service processes, parts

management, warranty, DMS/CRM tools.  

* Proven ability to coach and influence without authority.
* Analytical mindset with ability to interpret CSI/NPS data and workshop KPIs.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple dealership assignments simultaneously across geographies.
* Proficiency in audit and assessment methodologies.

  
**Qualifications**  
  

* Graduate in any discipline; Diploma/Degree in Automobile Engineering preferred.
* Certifications in training, coaching, or automotive service processes will be an added

advantage.  
  
**Other Requirements**  

* Willingness to travel extensively (pan India or within assigned region).
* Proficiency in English + regional language(s) preferred.
* Familiarity with OEM portals, DMS systems, and digital reporting tools.

  
**Key Performance Indicators**  

* Dealership CSI/NPS score improvement.
* Audit scores and process compliance rates.
* Staff skill improvement post-training.
* Number of dealerships coached/assessed per cycle.
* Repeat repair and complaint reduction rates.

MSX International has been a trusted partner to leading automotive OEMs and mobility companies worldwide, providing strategic support to transform retail operations. With a strong foundation built on Dealer Performance Improvement, Repair Optimization, and Consumer Engagement, we empower businesses by integrating people, processes, and technology to drive measurable success. As the mobility industry undergoes rapid transformation, MSX International stands as a catalyst for innovation, equipping clients with cutting-edge tools and deep industry expertise to navigate evolving market dynamics. MSX International remains the go-to partner for leading automotive OEMs, offering innovative, research-driven strategies to elevate retail operations and accelerate business growth.

title: Staff Technical Account Manager
description:
What You'll Do:

The Staff Technical Account Manager is responsible is a critical member of Avalara’s support organization, responsible for managing technical tickets, ensuring timely resolution, and driving customer satisfaction for our Enterprise. Involving complex product and connector issues that cannot be fully resolved through frontline troubleshooting alone, while improving the speed, quality, and consistency of engineering engagement. This is an engineering-aligned support talent that can reduce time to resolution, improve case quality, raise the standard of Jira submissions, and turn repeat issues into durable knowledge and process improvements. It also reflects Avalara’s broader need to embed AI into technical support in practical ways that improve investigation speed, communication quality, and team scalability. In addition to resolving complex issues, this role is expected to use AI in day-to-day work to accelerate research, strengthen technical analysis, improve case documentation, and identify opportunities to make technical support more effective and scalable over time.

The business outcome this role enables is straightforward: better customer experience, faster and more reliable resolution of complex cases, better use of engineering capacity, stronger support scalability, and fewer repeat incidents over time. By combining technical judgment with thoughtful AI adoption, this role also helps Avalara improve how support work is performed, not just how individual cases are resolved.

**How This Role Elevates Avalara**

* This role raises the technical bar of Enterprise Support by bringing stronger investigation discipline, better case documentation, cleaner handoffs, more effective Jira creation, and clearer collaboration with Product and Engineering. It also improves the capability of the broader support organization by turning difficult cases into reusable knowledge, troubleshooting actions, and support-ready guidance that reduces future rework.
* This role helps Avalara reduce unnecessary Jira volume, improve the quality of engineering escalations, and protect engineering capacity for the issues that truly require development effort. It also supports better operational performance through stronger SLA discipline, cleaner milestone adherence, faster TTR, and more predictable case outcomes.
* This role improves customer trust by ensuring that the most complex issues are handled with technical depth, clear communication, accurate diagnosis, and accountable resolution ownership. It also improves the long-term customer experience by reducing repeat incidents and strengthening self-service through better knowledge assets and preventative actions.
* Protect and increase Enterprise customer revenue and retention by resolving complex customer-impacting issues quickly and accurately.
* For customers, the TAM provides a trusted technical partner who understands their environment, anticipates risk, and delivers clarity during high-impact situations. This proactive, relationship-driven approach increases platform reliability, improves customer experience, and drives long-term success

What Your Responsibilities Will Be:

* Provide leadership and mentorship to TAMs – providing knowledge sessions, brown-bag training and advanced troubleshooting of APIs and ERPs.
* Own a portfolio of Avalara’s Enterprise customers with premium support entitlement.
* Own complex support cases from assignment through verified resolution, especially where advanced troubleshooting, reproduction, deep product analysis, or engineering coordination is required.
* Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis across ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms (NetSuite, D365, SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, Shopify, Workday, etc.).

* Diagnose customer issues across AvaTax, connectors, and related workflows by reproducing issues, gathering diagnostics, isolating scope, documenting findings, and confirming business impact.
* Determine when engineering involvement is warranted and ensure Jira tickets are necessary, complete, technically credible, and supported by strong due diligence before submission.
* Create, refine, and manage Jira tickets that clearly describe the issue, expected and actual behaviour, troubleshooting completed, reproduction detail, supporting evidence, and urgency.
* Partner closely with Product and Engineering to drive defect resolution, maintain momentum on linked development work, and keep customer cases moving while internal work is in progress.
* Maintain strong customer communication discipline by meeting milestone expectations, providing proactive updates, responding quickly to new customer messages, and keeping status and documentation audit ready.
* Improve support effectiveness beyond the individual case by completing troubleshooting of the issues and analysis on major or repeat issues and contributing knowledge articles, playbooks, or reusable troubleshooting guidance that reduce repeat volume.
* Contribute to High priority support or production-support responsiveness where applicable by providing fast technical guidance, validating escalation paths, and helping the broader support organization make better decisions earlier in the case lifecycle.
* Act as a technical role model for quality, ownership, and judgment in how cases are investigated, escalated, documented, and resolved.
* Contribute to responsible AI adoption by using sound judgment, validating outputs, and ensuring that final recommendations, communications, and actions remain accurate and customer ready.
* Help embed AI into support ways of working by sharing effective use cases, improving repeatable practices, and supporting continuous improvement across the team.

**12-Month Success Signals**

* Consistently meets or exceeds SLA targets and maintains high CSAT scores.
* Reduces complex escalation backlog and improves average resolution time.
* Contributes documented root-cause fixes that decrease repeat incidents.
* Delivers measurable efficiency gains through AI-assisted workflows (e.g., reduced case handling time, improved documentation speed).

  
What You'll Need to be Successful:

**At Avalara, this role is expected to be a bar raiser for Support Engineering, leveraging technical expertise, data-driven insights, and AI-enabled capabilities to elevate troubleshooting, accelerate issue resolution, and prevent recurring customer problems. They continuously improve support operations, knowledge management, and team effectiveness while delivering exceptional customer outcomes.**

  

* Raise the bar for the team. Provide guidance, improve execution quality, and leave cases, routing, and knowledge resources better than you found them.
* Own complex cases end to end. Drive the issue forward, clarify ambiguity, follow up proactively, and make sure cases do not stall waiting on others.
* Identify and drove resolution of recurring product defects, resulting in improved customer experience and reduced support volume.
* Consistently achieve high customer satisfaction scores through effective issue ownership, technical expertise, and proactive communication.
* Reduce critical issue resolution time to 5 days through structured root cause analysis and cross-functional collaboration.

**AI Bar Raiser Expectations:**  
  
**This role is expected to be an AI Bar Raiser, applying AI in a deliberate and impactful way to improve how technical issues are diagnosed, resolved, and prevented, while elevating the team’s ability to use AI to drive meaningful gains in support efficiency, knowledge quality, technical troubleshooting, and customer outcomes.**

* Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate root cause analysis and reduce troubleshooting time for complex customer issues.
* Identify and implement new AI-driven approaches to technical support (e.g., automated diagnostics, intelligent case triage, predictive risk identification) that go beyond current team practices
* Utilize Generative AI to create knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and customer-facing documentation, improving knowledge accessibility and consistency
* Develop AI-driven workflows that automated repetitive support tasks, increasing team productivity and reducing manual effort.
* Create AI-powered prompt libraries and support playbooks that standardized troubleshooting approaches across the team.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to integrate AI-driven customer feedback analysis into product improvement initiatives.
* Champion AI adoption across the support organization, driving measurable improvements in resolution efficiency and support quality.
* Use AI insights to prioritize critical customer issues based on business impact, severity, and historical trends.

**Qualifications A**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5+ years of proven experience in handling complex technical issues in SaaS, APIs, integrations, or similar environments, with strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills.
* Expert experience with ERP/CRM/eCommerce platforms: NetSuite, Microsoft Dynamics, SAP S/4 Hana, SageX, Salesforce, Magento, Oracle, Shopify, Workday, or similar systems is required
* Demonstrated proficiency in API and workflow analysis across ERP, e-Commerce, and Marketplace platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with Engineering/Product teams and manage high-quality escalation artifacts (e.g., Jira) with clear technical detail.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience working in SLA-driven support environments using tools such as Salesforce, Jira, and Confluence.
* Mandatory experience using AI tools and automation to improve support efficiency, diagnostics, communication quality, and scalability.

  
Avalara is an AI-first Company:

AI is embedded in our workflows, decision-making, and products. Success here requires embracing AI as an essential capability.

* You’ll bring experience using AI and AI-related technologies, ready to thrive here.
* You’ll apply AI every day to business challenges - improving efficiency, contributing solutions, and driving results for your team, our company, and our customers.
* You’ll grow with AI by staying curious about new trends and best practices, and by sharing what you learn so others can benefit too.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Total Rewards

In addition to a great compensation package, paid time off, and paid parental leave, many Avalara employees are eligible for bonuses.

Health & Wellness  
Benefits vary by location but generally include private medical, life, and disability insurance.

Inclusive culture and diversity  
Avalara strongly supports diversity, equity, and inclusion, and is committed to integrating them into our business practices and our organizational culture. We also have a total of 8 employee-run resource groups, each with senior leadership and exec sponsorship.

  
What You Need To Know About Avalara:

We’re defining the relationship between tax and tech.

We’ve already built an industry-leading cloud compliance platform, processing over 54 billion customer API calls and over 6.6 million tax returns a year. Our growth is real - we're a billion dollar business - and we’re not slowing down until we’ve achieved our mission - to be part of every transaction in the world.

We’re bright, innovative, and disruptive, like the orange we love to wear. It captures our quirky spirit and optimistic mindset. It shows off the culture we’ve designed, that empowers our people to win. We’ve been different from day one. Join us, and your career will be too.

**We’re An Equal Opportunity Employer**

Supporting diversity and inclusion is a cornerstone of our company — we don’t want people to fit into our culture, but to enrich it. All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, age, gender, national orientation, disability, sexual orientation, US Veteran status, or any other factor protected by law. If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know.

title: Manager – Merchant Acquisition & Partnerships
description:
**Role Overview**

The Merchant Acquisition Manager is responsible for driving the expansion of our merchant acceptance network across online (Payment Gateway, SDKs, checkout APIs) and offline/omnichannel (Smart POS, QR, soundboxes, sound-based payments) channels. This individual will identify high-growth merchants, navigate enterprise and mid-market commercial discussions, negotiate Merchant Discount Rates (MDR) and processing fees, and oversee smooth onboarding through go-live and activation. The primary mandate is scaling Total Payment Volume and expanding the company’s digital payments market share.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Pipeline Generation**

* + Identify, prospect, and acquire mid-market, D2C, e-commerce, and enterprise merchants across target verticals (Retail, Travel, Healthcare, Education, SaaS, and Gig Economy).
  + Manage the full enterprise/B2B sales cycle from cold outreach and discovery to solution demonstration, commercial closing, and contract execution.
  + Build strategic partnerships with platform integrators, e-commerce platforms (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento), ERP vendors, and system integrators to establish inbound acquisition funnels.

**2. Solution Consulting & Commercial Negotiation**

* + Conduct detailed consultations to map merchant checkout flows, drop-off pain points, payment failure rates, and settlement cycles to the company's aggregator solutions.
  + Structure commercially competitive yet margin-positive contracts, balancing MDR, platform fees, setup costs, settlement timeframes ( , , instant payouts), and chargeback liabilities.
  + Cross-sell value-added financial products, including instant payouts, recurring billing/e-mandates, BNPL/EMI integrations, working capital financing, and fraud mitigation tools.

**3. Onboarding, Integration & Go-Live Management**

* + Partner with the Technical Solutions / Integration Engineering team to ensure seamless API and SDK deployment on merchant platforms.
  + Coordinate with Risk, Compliance, and Underwriting teams to navigate Know Your Customer/Business (KYC/KYB), Merchant Category Code (MCC) classification, and regulatory compliance standards.
  + Track pipeline velocity to minimize onboarding turnaround time (TAT) and prevent drop-offs between contract signing and the first live transaction.

**4. Portfolio Activation & Early Ramp-Up**

* + Own merchant activation and volume ramp-up for the first 60–90 days post-go-live to guarantee transaction velocity and wallet-share dominance.
  + Analyze transaction analytics, success rates, route optimization, and failover configurations to troubleshoot early integration issues and ensure high authorization rates.

Handoff stabilized, high-performing accounts to the Key Account Management (KAM) team with comprehensive performance and revenue profiles

**Required Qualifications & Experience**

* + **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field; MBA is preferred.
  + **Experience:** 4–8 years of documented B2B sales, enterprise business development, or alliance management experience within a Payment Aggregator (PA), Payment Gateway (PG), Merchant Acquiring Bank, or Fintech company.
  + **Domain Knowledge:**
  + Comprehensive understanding of online and offline payment rails (Cards, UPI, Net Banking, Wallets, NACH/e-mandates, POS, Soundbox).
  + Sound knowledge of interchange economics, card brand scheme rules (Visa, Mastercard, RuPay), and central bank payment aggregator regulations.
  + Familiarity with technical integration mechanics (REST APIs, webhooks, mobile SDKs, server-to-server calls).
  + **Sales Track Record:** Consistent history of meeting or exceeding quarterly and annual net revenue.
  + **Communication & Negotiation:** Exceptional presentation, objection handling, and contract negotiation capabilities.

**Preferred Competencies**

* + Established network of executive and operational contacts within mid-market and enterprise D2C, retail, or tech ecosystems.
