title: Technical Training and Development Manager
description:
A Snapshot of Your Day (Technical Training & Development Manager)

As the Technical Training & Development Manager, you will play a key role in shaping the future workforce for Siemens Energy’s Greenfield manufacturing expansion. You will lead the development and execution of comprehensive training strategies for both white-collar and blue-collar employees, ensuring the organization is equipped with the technical capabilities required to support business growth and operational excellence.

In this leadership role, you will be responsible for designing role-based learning curricula, establishing a new training center, coordinating training delivery, and driving competency development across the organization. Working closely with local and global stakeholders, you will implement training initiatives, monitor learning effectiveness, and foster a culture of continuous improvement, safety, and quality. We are looking for an experienced professional with a strong background in manufacturing training, workforce capability development, and project execution, who can successfully build and scale training programs for a rapidly growing organization.

How You'll Make an Impact

* Develop and implement role-based curricula, competency frameworks, and training plans for various job profiles within the Greenfield factory in close collaboration with business stakeholders.

* Lead the planning, implementation, and successful establishment of a state-of-the-art training center for blue-collar employees, ensuring alignment with business and operational requirements.

* Coordinate training activities for both white-collar and blue-collar employees, collaborating with local management, operational teams, and key stakeholders to ensure effective workforce readiness.

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing training team responsible for organizing, managing, and delivering training programs and learning initiatives.

* Champion a strong culture of safety, quality, continuous improvement, and operational excellence throughout all training activities and development programs.

* Organize and manage internal and external trainers, mentors, and subject matter experts to effectively deliver technical, operational, and behavioral training programs.

* Deliver foundational training programs when required and serve as a backup trainer to ensure continuity and effectiveness of learning initiatives.

* Implement global training programs, learning tools, digital platforms, and content at the local level while ensuring alignment with organizational standards and best practices.

* Establish robust processes for tracking training activities, participant records, learning progress, certifications, and program effectiveness through relevant learning management and reporting systems.

* Monitor and report training KPIs, learning effectiveness metrics, and competency development progress to project leadership and global training organizations.

* Develop and maintain strategic partnerships with external training providers, including Engineering Colleges, Diploma Institutes, ITIs, vocational training centers, and other technical education institutes to strengthen talent pipelines and workforce capability development.

* Support workforce planning and organizational readiness initiatives by ensuring employees possess the technical and operational competencies needed to support current and future business requirements.

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Human Resources, Education, or a related field.

* Overall professional experience of 8-10 years, including a minimum of 5 years in training coordination, workforce development, talent development, or project management within a manufacturing environment.

* Proven experience in developing and implementing technical training programs, competency frameworks, learning curricula, and training delivery models.

* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to effectively plan, coordinate, monitor, and execute multiple training initiatives simultaneously.

* Experience establishing or supporting training centers, technical academies, workforce development programs, or large-scale learning initiatives is highly desirable.

* Previous leadership experience with the ability to build, mentor, and lead high-performing learning and development teams.

* Knowledge of power transformer manufacturing, electrical equipment, industrial manufacturing processes, or related engineering industries is highly desirable.

* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in a global and multicultural environment.

* Experience working with learning management systems (LMS), training administration tools, competency management systems, and learning analytics is preferred.

* Formal certifications in Training, Adult Learning, Instructional Design, Learning & Development, Project Management, or related disciplines will be considered an advantage.

* Fluency in English with strong verbal, written, presentation, and facilitation skills.

* A passion for developing people, building future capabilities, and creating a sustainable learning culture that supports organizational growth.

About the Team

Our Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high-voltage switchgear and transformers, and digital grid technology.

The Greenfield factory expansion represents a significant milestone in Siemens Energy's growth journey. As we prepare the workforce of the future, the Training & Development function will play a critical role in ensuring employees have the required technical capabilities, operational competencies, and leadership skills to support world-class manufacturing operations and drive long-term business success.

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL)

Siemens Energy India Limited (SEIL) has been a strategic partner in India for more than 100 years and is focused on being the most-valued energy technology company. Our large footprint spread across the entire region (India, Sri Lanka, Bhutan, Nepal, Maldives) with state-of-the-art facilities and customer installations positively impacts the lives of hundreds of millions of people, helping countries navigate their energy transition and achieve their net-zero targets.

SEIL is a pure-play energy technology company, offering a comprehensive portfolio of products, solutions, and services designed to support our customers along the entire energy value chain through their energy transition journey. Our portfolio includes low-to-zero emissions power generation, power transmission and storage, and industrial decarbonization solutions.

This is a unique opportunity to join the Client Account Services Platform & Strategy team and partner with Product, Operations and Technology to deliver strategic Account and Standing Settlement Instruction Reference Data capabilities across the Commercial & Investment Bank

**Role Summary**

As a Product Delivery Manager within Client Account Services Change & Strategy, you will lead the end-to-end delivery of capabilities, features and releases across the Account and Standing Settlement Instruction Reference Data product suite. You will partner with Product Manager, Technology, Operations and Control teams to translate product strategy and roadmaps into well-defined delivery outcomes, executable release plans, operational adoption and measurable business value. You will shape delivery through epics, features, user stories, backlog refinement, sequencing and release readiness. You will maintain a strong product delivery cadence, address barriers to execution and provide transparency on release health, quality and risk. You will remain accountable for adoption, customer outcomes, feedback loops and continuous improvement following implementation.

**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of product capabilities, features and releases, aligned with the agreed product vision, roadmap and priorities.

* Partner with Product Managers to translate strategic outcomes into clear epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and executable delivery plans.

* Shape and maintain delivery-ready backlogs through effective prioritisation, refinement and sequencing across Product, Technology, Operations and Control teams.

* Own the delivery lifecycle from discovery and definition through build, testing, implementation, stabilisation, adoption and continuous improvement.

* Lead release planning, coordinating scope, milestones, readiness criteria, implementation activities, controls, training, communications and post-release support.

* Maintain transparency of delivery confidence, release health, quality, risks and decisions, escalating barriers early and driving timely resolution.

* Establish an effective product delivery cadence through backlog refinement, planning, demonstrations, readiness reviews and retrospectives.

* Coordinate delivery across interconnected product capabilities and teams, managing dependencies, sequencing and cross-team impacts while retaining clear product delivery accountability.

* Define and track KPIs, OKRs, adoption measures, customer outcomes and value-realisation criteria, using performance insights and feedback to drive continuous improvement, process simplification, automation and AI-enabled opportunities.

* Lead and develop junior Product Owners, Business Analysts and delivery professionals, reinforcing clear accountabilities and high-quality product delivery practices.

* Build strong cross-functional partnerships and influence senior stakeholders through clear communication of delivery outcomes, release health, trade-offs, customer impact and value realised.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills**

* Extensive experience leading product delivery, product transformation or complex capability delivery within Financial Services.

* Proven experience delivering products and releases across Product, Technology, Operations and Control organizations.

* Strong practical knowledge of Agile delivery methods, the product lifecycle and backlog management.

* Strong analytical, problem-solving, decision-making, communication, presentation and leadership capabilities.

* Working knowledge of Investment Banking, Reference Data domains and/or the settlement lifecycle.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities and Skills**

* Experience delivering strategic data, platform and operating model transformation capabilities.

* Experience working with product roadmaps, KPIs, OKRs, adoption measures, customer outcomes and value-realisation frameworks.

* Lean Six Sigma, Agile, SAFe, PMP, PRINCE2 or a related professional certification.

* Bachelor's or master's degree in Finance, Business, Technology, Mathematics, Statistics or a related discipline.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Senior P&C Coordinator
description:
**About Energy Exemplar**

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar's mission lies in 'Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions'. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast and that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that's at home, in the office, or on the move.

We're a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You'll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren't just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the** **Position**

As Senior P&C Coordinator, you'll have the opportunity to shape the employee experience at Energy Exemplar, supporting assigned business functions across India. As the day-to-day P&C contact for managers and employees, you'll build trusted relationships, understand team priorities and turn employee feedback and people data into practical recommendations that make a difference.

You'll take ownership of key moments in the employee journey, from welcoming new starters and supporting probation through to offboarding, coordinating with relevant teams to deliver a smooth and positive experience. You'll also help bring people programmes to life, guide managers through established policies and processes, and partner with the Senior Director, P&C on sensitive or complex matters.

This opportunity will suit someone who enjoys connecting with people, solving problems and taking initiative. How you work matters as much as what you deliver. We are looking for someone who brings a positive, constructive attitude, contributes to team success, actively seeks and applies feedback, and takes initiative to follow things through. The role offers opportunities to broaden your contribution and responsibility as you demonstrate sound judgment, consistent delivery and impact.

  

**Key Accountabilities and Duties**

* Provide quality, timely and professional P&C advice to managers and employees on established people processes and policies and build effective working relationships with stakeholders across assigned functions.

* Partner with managers to understand business priorities, team capability needs, employee motivations and retention risks, and help translate these into practical people actions for their teams.

* Support the delivery of performance and development processes, including goal and review cycles, development plans, talent discussions and follow-up on agreed actions.

* Work with managers to interpret engagement survey results and employee feedback, identify themes, agree relevant actions and monitor progress.

* Be accountable for the onboarding experience for employees, including Energy Exemplar's sign-to-start programme, manager readiness, induction coordination and probation follow-up. Identify opportunities to improve the new-joiner experience.

* Conduct 30, 60 and 90 day new-joiner check-ins to assess the onboarding experience, identify issues requiring follow-up and share themes with managers and P&C leadership.

* Coordinate employee changes and offboarding, conduct exit interviews where appropriate, and identify themes and recommendations for action.

* Ensure the accurate and timely administration and safekeeping of employee records, HRIS information and documentation in line with local requirements and Global P&C processes.

* Produce accurate and informative reports, including headcount, attrition, onboarding, engagement and employee movements, and share insights and recommendations with relevant stakeholders.

* Collaborate with the Global P&C team and internal partners to deliver consistent people processes and employee experiences across locations and suggest improvements to established practices.

* Escalate sensitive employee relations matters, disciplinary issues, separations, compensation or policy exceptions, and significant people risks to the Senior Director, P&C for review and decision.

* Use approved AI tools where appropriate to improve the quality and efficiency of P&C communications, reporting, analysis and routine workflows; verify outputs before use and protect confidential employee information.

  

**Candidate Requirements**

* Constructive attitude and teamwork: Approaches challenges with a practical, solution-focused mindset, supports colleagues and contributes to shared outcomes. Willingly takes on the detailed and routine work needed to deliver a strong employee experience.

* Coachability and self-awareness: Actively seeks feedback, listens openly, takes responsibility for errors and demonstrates how learning translates into improved performance.

* Initiative and follow-through: Identifies what needs attention, recommends practical action and follows through on commitments without repeated prompting. Knows when to act independently and when to seek guidance.

* Learning and growth: Shows curiosity about the business and the P&C profession, applies new learning and builds credibility through the quality and impact of their work.

* Collaborative confidence: Listens to different perspectives, shares credit and adapts their approach when presented with better information. Can respectfully question an approach and offer an alternative.

* 5 to 7 years of relevant experience in an HR generalist or people advisory role, including direct support to managers; experience in a product technology or software environment is an advantage.

* Working understanding of India employment practices, HR compliance and relevant labour legislation, with the judgment to recognise when specialist advice is needed.

* Experience supporting employee lifecycle processes, performance and engagement programmes, and interpreting people data to recommend actions.

* Ability to build trust with managers and employees, ask thoughtful questions, communicate clearly and follow issues through to resolution.

* Strong organisational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to balance portfolio priorities and deliver accurate work in a changing environment.

* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word; experience with BambooHR or a similar HRIS is desirable.

* AI readiness: confidence using approved AI tools for drafting, analysis and routine workflows; ability to write useful prompts, verify results against source information, recognise errors or bias, and handle employee data in line with company requirements.

  

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resource Management or related field

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

*Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate* *Privacy Notice* *explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.*

title: Head of AI Solutions & Delivery
description:
**About TVARIT:**

TVARIT GmbH specializes in developing and delivering cutting-edge artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for the metal industry, including steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and more. Our software products empower customers to make intelligent, data-driven decisions, driving

advancements in Predictive Quality (PsQ), Predictive Maintenance (PdM), and Energy Consumption Reduction (PsE).

With a strong portfolio of renowned reference customers, state-of-the-art technology, a talented research team from prestigious universities, and recognition through esteemed awards such as the EU Horizon 2020 AI Prize, TVARIT is recognized as one of the most

innovative AI companies in Germany and Europe.

We are looking for a self-motivated person with a positive “can-do” attitude and excellent oral and written communication skills in English.

**About the Role:**

We are looking for a senior leader to head TVARIT’s Metals Division, owning customer relationships, solution delivery, and the growth of our industrial AI business with steel, aluminum, copper, cast iron, and other metal producers and processors. The role calls for an engineer who combines first-hand manufacturing plant experience, ideally in metals, with strong data science and AI expertise and a proven record of leading software delivery with a team

The Head of AI Solutions & Delivery will be the senior face of TVARIT to metals customers, from the first discovery workshop through deployment and scaled adoption, and will be accountable for delivering projects on time, within scope, and with measurable impact on

quality, yield, uptime, and energy consumption. The role leads a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, software engineers, and domain experts, and turns successful deployments into reusable, scalable offerings for the metals sector.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Division Leadership & Growth:**

* Lead the Metals Division end to end, including strategy, customer portfolio, revenue and delivery targets, and division-level planning and reporting.
* Build, lead, and mentor a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, ML engineers, software engineers, and metallurgy/process domain experts; set clear goals, hiring plans, and standards of technical excellence.
* Define the division’s solution and product roadmap together with product and business teams, prioritizing use cases with recurring demand across steel, aluminum, and other metal processes.
* Grow existing accounts and win new business through solution design, technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, proof-of-concept planning, and commercial discussions.

**Customer Engagement:**

* Act as the senior technical and executive point of contact for metals customers, building trusted relationships with plant managers, process and quality engineers, IT/OT teams, and senior decision makers.
* Lead discovery discussions and requirements workshops, on the shop floor and in the boardroom, to understand manufacturing processes, operational challenges, existing systems, and business priorities.
* Translate customer needs into clearly defined use cases, solution concepts, highlevel architectures, implementation scope, and measurable success criteria.
* Present TVARIT’s capabilities through relevant project examples, demonstrations, and workshops, communicating methodology, technical differentiation, limitations, and expected business value credibly to technical and executive audiences

**Delivery Excellence:**

* Own delivery of all Metals Division projects, from scoping and data onboarding through model development, deployment, user adoption, and value realization, ensuring on-time, on-budget, high-quality outcomes.
* Establish delivery governance across projects: plans and milestones, risk and dependency management, customer status reporting, and escalation handling.
* Assess feasibility before commitment, considering data readiness, integration with PLC/SCADA, MES, and historians, deployment constraints, effort, and business impact; align customer commitments with team capacity and technical readiness.
* Track and demonstrate realized value (e.g., scrap reduction, yield, first-pass quality, energy per tonne, unplanned downtime) and use proven results to drive renewals and expansion.

**Technical, Data Science & AI Leadership:**

* Provide hands-on technical direction on data science and ML approaches for metal processes, including time-series modeling, predictive quality, predictive maintenance, process optimization, and hybrid physics-informed models.
* Review solution architectures and engineering practices for robustness, scalability, and maintainability; set standards for software delivery, MLOps, and model monitoring.
* Identify reusable intellectual property across projects, including models, algorithms, software components, and process expertise, and guide its development into configurable, scalable products for the metals sector with minimal incremental development where feasible.
* Stay current on industrial AI, including generative AI and industrial copilots, and evaluate where they add real value for metals customers.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering (Metallurgical, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Computer Science, or a related discipline); a postgraduate qualification in Data Science, AI, or Computer Science is an advantage.
* **10+ years of professional experience,** including substantial experience leading teams and customer engagements in industrial AI, manufacturing technology, industrial software, or technology-led solution delivery.
* **Mandatory manufacturing exposure:** direct experience working in or closely with manufacturing plants and their operations teams. Metals experience (e.g., steel, aluminum, copper, foundry/casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment) is strongly preferred; automotive, heavy engineering, or process manufacturing is also considered
* **Software delivery leadership:** must have led the delivery of software products or solutions with a team, with a solid working understanding of the software development lifecycle (requirements, design, development, testing, release, and maintenance) and agile delivery practices. Hands-on coding exposure (e.g., Python) is mandatory; professional software development experience is an advantage.
* **Mandatory AI modeling experience:** strong understanding of AI/ML modeling (problem framing, feature engineering, model selection, validation, and deployment considerations) and hands-on involvement in AI/ML modeling projects, ideally on industrial, sensor, or time-series data.
* **Proven customer-facing leadership**, including requirements gathering, technical presentations, executive stakeholder management, and managing customer expectations through delivery
* **Proven delivery track record:** leading complex, multi-stakeholder technology projects to successful deployment, with accountability for timelines, scope, quality, and customer satisfaction.
* Experience in solution architecture, presales, technical proposals, or productizing project work into reusable offerings.
* Strong people leadership, with experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams; excellent written and verbal communication, structured problemsolving, and the ability to represent TVARIT confidently with senior stakeholders.
* Willingness to travel to customer plants as required.

**Technical Skills**

**Strong Haves**

* **Data science and AI:** Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, time-series analysis, anomaly detection, predictive and prescriptive analytics, optimization, and hybrid physics-informed modeling, with a clear view of their practical applications and limitations.
* **Metals process understanding:** Ability to relate process parameters in melting, casting, rolling, forging, extrusion, or heat treatment to quality, yield, scrap, energy consumption, equipment health, and operating cost.
* **Software development lifecycle:** Working understanding of how industrial software is planned, built, tested, released, and supported, including agile practices, CI/CD, code quality, and testing, sufficient to lead engineering teams and make sound delivery trade-offs. Hands-on coding exposure in Python is required, along with working familiarity with SQL.
* **Solution architecture and productization:** Translating business and operational requirements into functional specifications, reference architectures, and implementation roadmaps; reusable components, configurable solutions, model generalization, and validation across plants.

Familiarity Needed

* **Industrial data and integration:** Familiarity with PLC/SCADA systems, historians, MES, sensors, lab and quality data, and manufacturing data platforms, including data quality, contextualization, and OT/IT integration
* **Deployment and MLOps:** Cloud, edge, and on-premises deployment, MLOps, model monitoring and retraining, security, and reliability. Familiarity with Azure is preferred; AWS or GCP experience is also relevant.
* **Emerging AI:** Awareness of generative AI, LLMs, and industrial copilots, including their practical applications and limitations in manufacturing

description:

If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

**Job Details**
===============

SAP Basis Administrator

POSITION SUMMARY:

SAP Systems Administrators are responsible for maintaining the ongoing reliability, performance, management and support of the SAP systems environment. SAP environments may include but are not limited to: Administration, Sales, Distribution, etc. Responsibilities include managing applications and systems, responding to problems and planning for growth. SAP Systems Administrators understand the technical infrastructure standards and requirements for the integration of specific SAP modules. This may include migration tasks such as change request review, software build coordination, release documentation, production issue resolution and tracking report distribution. They also understand the business implications of application and system problems allowing them to appropriately set severity levels when problems do occur. SAP Systems Administrators monitor the performance of system applications. Individuals execute contingency plans in case of system outages, troubleshoot a wide variety of technical problems and provide Level II support to the Help Desk. In addition, these roles participate in projects to implement SAP services such as initial installation, as well as subsequent installations of updates and patches.

PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

* Works on multiple, high to highly complex projects.
* Maintains SAP systems and applications, supporting and training users for SAP system(s) and applications usage.
* Supports integration of changes in test, pre-production and production environments.
* Works with production quality assurance/testing team to ensure appropriate level of testing has been completed prior to implementation of change.

* Ensures the performance and reliability of SAP systems.

* Experience with systems and database administration.

* Requires skills in multiple technical environments and knowledge of a specific business area.
* Requires certification in specific areas (i.e., Basis, Oracle, Hana).
* Strong organization skills
* Good analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing
* Exceptional customer service skills

* Experience across multiple SAP software products. (e.g. ECC, BW, PI)
* Good group presentation skills

* Extensive knowledge of troubleshooting complex SAP performance problems.

title: Software Maintenance Renewal Specialist
description:

What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------

As a Software Renewal Specialist on our Renewal Operations Team, you will be responsible for the software license contract renewals for AspenTech's worldwide customers. You will drive and execute the process from quote creation and commercials, to contract signature and purchase order receipt, and then order entry for invoicing. This position is in our Revenue Sales Operations organization and will require excellent customer service skills and business acumen as well as strong collaboration with internal teams such as Sales, Finance, and Legal.

**Your Impact**
---------------

* Research software license agreements and renewal history to identify and understand upcoming license contract renewals
* Create license contract renewal quotes and work with the Sales Account Managers and Commercial team to improve deal metrics and outcomes
* Follow-up with Sales Account Managers and/or customers to ensure acceptance of the quotes, contract signatures, and submission of purchase orders as needed to meet our renewal metrics
* Work closely with customers to address their concerns and questions while using the escalation and approval chain to obtain needed help and approvals for any changes
* Collaborate with internal AspenTech resources (e.g. Sales Account Manager, Customer Success Managers, Support, Sales Ops, Finance, Legal) to expedite closure of contracts

title: Territory Business Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Business Manger” to drive sales of pharmaceutical products in your assigned territory. You will gather market intelligence, conduct prescription audits, and implement sales strategies to achieve sales targets. Additionally, you will manage queries from doctors, maintain customer relationships, and ensure accurate territory data management.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for understanding market trends and competition status by gathering information from stockists and chemists and relaying this data to the Sales Business Manager (SBM) or Regional Sales Manager (RSM).
* You will be responsible for conducting Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) on doctors in the assigned area to identify potential high-prescribers and providing the final list of doctors likely to prescribe large quantities to the SBM/RSM for sales forecasting purposes.
* You will be responsible for attending relevant training programs and staying updated on product literature.
* You will be responsible for obtaining sales targets and promotion budget details from SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for utilizing the allocated budget to plan launch activities for different doctors, camps, or Continuing Medical Education (CME) sessions in the assigned area.
* You will be responsible for conducting regular sales pitches and presentations with doctors to promote products.
* You will be responsible for submitting reimbursement bills to SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for implementing marketing plans provided by the Product Manager.
* You will be responsible for gathering Point of Business (POB) details from chemists and coordinating with stockists to ensure product delivery.
* You will be responsible for monitoring and tracking sales of new products with chemists to achieve sales targets.
* You will be responsible for collecting queries from doctors regarding both new and existing products.
* You will be responsible for entering queries into the system for review by the Infogini team.
* You will be responsible for utilizing email responses from Infogini to address doctors' queries and increase prescriptions per doctor.
* You will be responsible for maintaining regular interactions with doctors to understand their prescription trends.
* You will be responsible for communicating prescription trend data to SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for keeping track of specific customer needs and providing feedback to Area Sales Manager (ASM), SBM/RSM, or Head Office (HO).
* You will be responsible for preparing lists of doctors for all CME events and submitting them to SBM/RSM to foster strong relationships and loyalty among doctors.
* You will be responsible for maintaining and updating data on doctor lists, route maps, retailers, and other supply chain contacts in the internal database.
* You will be responsible for ensuring accurate management of sales activities to optimize sales volume and effectiveness.

 **Qualifications**

**Educational qualification-** Graduate with science background.  
  
**Minimum work experience-** 3-5 years of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  
  
**Skills & attributes**  
**Technical Skills**  

* Deep understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing.
* Understanding of key trends in Pharmaceutical Sales.
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong decision-making skills.

  
  
**Additional Information**

**About the Department**  
**Global Generics India**  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  
  
**Benefits Offered**  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
**Our Work Culture**  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  
For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

=============================

-------------------------------------------

--------------------------------------

**Automation, Integration & Reporting**
---------------------------------------

* Design, implement, and maintain Jira automation rules to streamline repetitive tasks, improve data quality, and reduce manual effort.

* Develop dashboards and reports to track Agile delivery metrics, SLA compliance, service performance, backlog health, and operational trends.

**User Support, Governance & Documentation**
--------------------------------------------

* Manage user onboarding, access provisioning, role changes, and support processes in alignment with governance requirements.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to review requirements, recommend platform solutions, and ensure sustainable adoption.

**Professional & Technical Skills-**
====================================

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* Strong hands-on experience administering **Atlassian Jira Software** and **Jira Service Management** in a cloud environment.
* Proficiency in configuring workflows, screens, schemes, issue types, custom fields, permissions, and notification settings.
* Experience supporting ITSM practices, including request management, incident management, service workflows, SLAs, queues, and escalation paths.
* Working knowledge of Jira Automation, dashboard creation, filters, reports, and operational metrics.
* Strong understanding of user management, access control, security models, and governance practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot Jira-related performance, access, workflow, automation, and configuration issues.
* Experience administering or supporting Confluence, including knowledge base and documentation use cases.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work with technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Experience with Atlassian Marketplace apps such as ScriptRunner, Temo Timesheets, Xray, Zephyr or similar automation/configuration tools.
* Exposure to Atlassian Rovo, including AI-powered search, chat, agents, knowledge discovery, and adoption enablement across Jira, Jira Service Management, and Confluence.

* Scripting experience using Groovy, Python, or related technologies.
* Experience with Jira migrations, including cloud-to-cloud project or instance migrations.

Senior Manager, Process Automation COE

title: Project Scheduler
description:
**Job Description**

**ABOUT VICTAULIC**

**Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.**

**Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures.**

**Project Scheduler:-**

Planning, Scheduling & Resource Coordination | Monitoring, Forecasting & Management Reporting

**Department:-** VDC Operations

**Reports to:-** Senior BIM Manager

**POSITION SUMMARY:-**

The Project Scheduler develops and maintains integrated project schedules, coordinates resources against priorities and capacity, and monitors progress to surface risks early. This role provides the planning discipline and reporting rigor that keeps VDC activities aligned with engineering, fabrication, construction, and customer timelines.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:-**

* Create and maintain integrated project schedules covering design, coordination, reviews, approvals, and

deliverables.

* Coordinate resource loading with project priorities, available capacity, and required skill sets.
* Identify dependencies, constraints, and critical activities before they affect project milestones.
* Align VDC activities with engineering, fabrication, construction, and customer timelines.
* Standardize scheduling methods, milestone definitions, and progress measurements across projects.
* Improve work allocation by providing clear short-term and long-term priorities to the team. Monitoring, Forecasting & Management Reporting
* Track planned versus actual progress and highlight schedule risks, delays, and recovery needs early.
* Prepare weekly look-ahead plans, milestone status updates, and management dashboards.
* Forecast workload, resource demand, and potential bottlenecks to support staffing decisions.
* Coordinate with project leads to develop practical recovery plans and revised priorities.
* Improve accountability through clear ownership, target dates, and follow-up on commitments.
* Provide reliable schedule data for leadership reviews, customer updates, and business planning.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:-**

* Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience as a scheduler or planner in a VDC, construction, or engineering environment.
* Proficiency with scheduling software (e.g., Primavera P6, Microsoft Project) and reporting/dashboard tools.
* Strong understanding of resource loading, critical path methodology, and milestone tracking.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent project schedules.
* Strong communication skills to coordinate across engineering, fabrication, construction, and customer teams.

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES:-**

* Schedule accuracy and on-time milestone delivery across projects.
* Early identification and mitigation of schedule risks and bottlenecks.
* Consistency of scheduling methods and reporting across the project portfolio.
* Quality and reliability of forecasting used in staffing and business decisions.

title: Manager, Product Development
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Product DevelopmentOverview  
  
We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Manager, Product Development to drive the development and evolution of next-generation payment capabilities within Mastercard's global network platforms. This role is responsible for defining product strategy, managing product roadmaps, translating business opportunities into scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver impactful payment products.  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise, deep payments domain knowledge, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization. This individual must be comfortable operating in complex, highly technical environments while maintaining a relentless focus on customer value, business outcomes, and execution excellence.  
  
Product Strategy & Roadmap:  

* Define and manage product vision, roadmap, and requirements for strategic payment platform initiatives.
* Identify customer, operational, and market opportunities that can be translated into scalable product capabilities.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to evaluate product investments using quantitative and qualitative data.
* Drive prioritization decisions based on customer impact, business value, risk, and delivery feasibility.
* Develop short-term and long-term product strategies aligned with organizational objectives.

  
Product Development & Execution:  

* Lead end-to-end product development from concept through launch and adoption.
* Create clear business requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and success metrics.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Technical Product Managers throughout the product lifecycle.
* Manage product backlogs and roadmap execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Facilitate trade-off discussions and drive timely decision making across complex cross-functional programs.

  
Stakeholder Management & Leadership:  

* Influence senior leaders, engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to align around product vision and priorities.
* Present product strategy, roadmap progress, business cases, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders.
* Coordinate across global teams, regional partners, and operations organizations to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for payment network products and platform capabilities.

Data-Driven Decision Making:  

* Define and monitor product KPIs, adoption metrics, operational performance indicators, and business outcomes.
* Leverage data analytics to identify opportunities, assess product performance, and drive prioritization decisions.
* Create executive-ready presentations, dashboards, business cases, and strategic recommendations.
* Utilize analytical insights to continuously optimize product performance and customer experience.

  
AI & Innovation:  

* Apply AI-powered tools and techniques to improve product discovery, requirements management, decision-making, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into payment products, operational workflows, or customer-facing solutions.
* Leverage modern AI tools in day-to-day product management activities, including research, analysis, documentation, planning, and stakeholder communications.

  
Required Qualifications  
  
Experience:  

* 6-10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Technical Product Management, or related disciplines.
* Proven experience building and launching customer-facing digital products, payment products, or platform capabilities.
* Demonstrated ownership of product roadmaps and delivery of complex cross-functional initiatives.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
#### **About Us**

**ISMG**is a global intelligence firm and media powerhouse, leading the way in cybersecurity, enterprise IT, and digital transformation. With 10+ brands, 38 digital media properties, and over 400 premier events annually—ISMG connects a network of over 2M executives, decision-makers, and innovators with the insights and opportunities they need to stay ahead.

We’re seeking a strategic, proactive, and highly organized **Customer Success Manager** to join our fast-growing Digital Campaigns team. This is a high-impact, client-facing role focused on driving campaign success, strengthening client relationships, and delivering a best-in-class customer experience across a large portfolio of digital marketing programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys balancing multiple priorities, and brings a consultative, solutions-oriented mindset to client management. More than a traditional “issue-response” CSM, we’re looking for someone who can act as a strategic campaign partner — proactively guiding clients, identifying opportunities, and owning the narrative and success of each engagement.

You’ll collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Leadership teams while serving as a trusted advisor to clients across the cybersecurity and enterprise technology landscape.

#### **What You'll Do**

* Manage a high volume of concurrent digital marketing campaigns while ensuring timelines, deliverables, and client expectations are consistently met.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for clients throughout the campaign lifecycle, building trusted relationships through proactive communication, strategic guidance, and exceptional service.
* Lead client touchpoints including campaign kickoffs, insight calls, performance reviews, and strategic planning discussions.
* Monitor campaign performance, analyze KPIs, identify trends, and proactively address risks or gaps to ensure successful outcomes.
* Partner closely with Account Executives and internal stakeholders to support client retention, growth opportunities, and overall account success.
* Translate campaign performance data into actionable recommendations and strategic insights for clients.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Campaign Operations, Sales, Product, and Leadership teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
* Contribute to process improvements, operational efficiency initiatives, and evolving best practices as the Customer Success function continues to scale and mature.
* Maintain accurate documentation, client notes, and campaign tracking within Salesforce, Monday.com, and other internal systems.

#### **What You Bring to the Table**

* 3–5 years of experience in a client-facing Customer Success, Account Management, Campaign Management, Sales Planning, Client Services, or Digital Marketing role.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.
* Strong preference for candidates with experience in B2B media, ad tech, digital publishing, agency, or integrated marketing environments.
* Proven ability to manage multiple high-volume campaigns simultaneously with strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
* Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to confidently engage with clients, internal stakeholders, and executive-level contacts.
* Strategic and proactive mindset with strong problem-solving abilities and a sense of ownership over client outcomes.
* Comfortable navigating ambiguity, adapting quickly, and operating independently in a growing and evolving team environment.
* Ability to analyze campaign performance data, identify trends, and communicate insights effectively.
* Experience with Salesforce, campaign management platforms, or project management tools such as Monday.com is a plus.
* Familiarity with cybersecurity, enterprise technology, digital media, or B2B marketing is strongly preferred.

#### **Why ISMG?**

* Join a global, fast-growing media and intelligence organization at the forefront of cybersecurity, AI, and enterprise technology.
* Be part of a highly collaborative, evolving Customer Success organization with significant opportunity for growth and career development.
* Work alongside talented sales, operations, editorial, and marketing professionals driving impactful client programs for leading enterprise brands.
* Gain exposure to strategic client partnerships, innovative digital campaign solutions, and executive-level stakeholder engagement.
* Thrive in a culture that values accountability, initiative, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Ready to be part of something bigger? Apply now or visit**ISMG.io**to learn more!

title: Business Head, Pinterest Partnership (India)
description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**

At **Aleph**, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.

Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.

With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.

**About the role**

Aleph is Pinterest’s exclusive managed service partner in India, and partners with Pinterest across markets in EMEA, APAC and LATAM. Aleph’s Pinterest team has been scaling India for the last three years, and we are now looking for an experienced commercial leader to take this growth to its next stage. You will own the India business for the Pinterest partnership, lead the local team, and be the senior face of the business to India’s leading brands and agencies.

### **What you will do:**

**Grow and diversify our base**

* Own India revenue, forecast and agency incentivisation, delivering quarterly targets while diversifying our customer base.
* Build pipeline in India’s largest categories (FMCG, e-commerce, retail, travel and automotive) with clear vertical plays.
* Lift retention and spend per account through structured account reviews and QBRs, so advertisers grow with us.

  
**Win with agencies**

* Lead senior relationships with agency holding companies and independent agencies, and shape incentive structures that grow committed spend.
* Make the case for managed Pinterest investment against programmatic alternatives.

  
**Partner with marketing**

* Be the India point of contact for Pinterest’s and Aleph’s marketing teams, shaping and supporting ROI-driven local events, agency roadshows, Pinterest certification programmes and insights workshops for global brands.

  
**Lead the team**

* Lead, coach and retain a team of Client Partners and Client Service Managers, keeping sellers focused on selling and hunting.
* Hire well, build a succession bench, and create a culture of accountability and accurate forecasting.

  
**Operate with rigour**

* Lead India’s weekly business review with Pinterest, covering pipeline stages, forecast accuracy, churn and spend-per-account trends.
* Work with Aleph’s global operations and customer success teams on onboarding, integrations and reporting.
* Communicate clearly across regional and global time zones, and bring Pinterest’s product and marketing teams the specific asks that unlock growth in India.

  
**Represent the business**

* Act as Aleph’s senior voice for the Pinterest partnership in India’s advertising ecosystem, at industry events, agency forums and client leadership meetings.

### **What you need:**

* 10+ years in digital media sales, including at least 4 years leading sales teams against revenue targets.
* Senior relationships across India’s agency holding companies and major brand advertisers, ideally in FMCG or e-commerce.
* A track record of growing an advertiser base, not only landing large deals. You will be asked to show retention and account-growth results.
* Strong commercial and analytical skills: forecasting, P&L ownership, and turning data into decisions.
* Experience building teams and processes in a fast-changing, matrixed environment.
* Business-level fluency in English. Hindi or another Indian language is a plus.
* Proficiency in Salesforce and reporting tools such as Tableau or Looker.
* A bachelor’s degree is preferred.

### **Nice to have :**

* Experience in a reseller, partner or managed-service model for a global platform.
* Knowledge of lower-funnel, performance and shopping ad products, and how they compete with Meta, Google and programmatic.
* Experience with app-install or gaming advertisers.

### **What success looks like in year one :**

* A broad advertiser base, growing across multiple categories.
* Retained advertisers growing their spend year on year.
* At least one new category established as a meaningful revenue line.
* A stable team with low regretted attrition, and forecasts the business trusts.

**Why Join Us?**

Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.

We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

We use Lever, our recruitment management platform, which includes AI-powered features that may assist our hiring team in reviewing applications, analyzing CVs, and identifying relevant qualifications. These tools support - but do not replace - human judgement. All hiring decisions are made by people. For more information about how your personal data is processed, including your rights in relation to AI-assisted processing, please see our Candidate Privacy Policy or contact us at privacy@alephdigital.com.

title: General Manager
description:
Vaisala is a global leader in measurement instruments and intelligence helping industries, nations, people, and the planet to thrive. From predicting hurricanes to optimizing renewable energy production, our technology is used where it matters the most – from data centers, windfarms and laboratories to airports, the Arctic and even the surface of Mars. For a second year running, Vaisala got recognized in TIME Magazine's World's Best Companies in Sustainable Growth 2026 study. Driven by our shared purpose, curiosity, and pioneering spirit, we stay ahead and make a difference. At Vaisala, you don't have to fit in to belong.

**General Manager India**

The General Manager position in our India office is accountable for the overall commercial performance, strategic market development, customer engagement, and organizational leadership of the Vaisala Industrial Measurements business in India, driving profitable growth and strengthening Vaisala's market position in one of the company's most important growth markets.

**Main responsibilities**

Your key responsibilities include:

* Lead and manage Vaisala’s Industrial Measurements India organization including
  

* + Develop and execute the India growth strategy aligned with APAC and Vaisala Industrial Measurements business priorities
  + Own and deliver India Industrial Measurements sales targets, orders intake, revenue, profitability, and market share objectives
  + Drive sales excellence through opportunity management, forecasting accuracy, and disciplined CRM (salesforce) utilization
  + Lead strategic account planning and executive-level customer engagement.
  + Uphold the company’s performance standards for the team through active performance based measurement and line management.
  + Provide guidance for day to day operations for the India Sales activities including logistics, Human resources and finance.
  + Promote the Vaisala ways of working and culture

* Market Development and Strategy including
  + Identify emerging market opportunities, industry trends, and strategic growth segments within India
  + Develop country-specific go-to-market plans to accelerate growth in both direct and indirect sales channels
  + Strengthen Vaisala's market positioning and brand presence through customer engagement, industry associations, and key events.
  + Defining and agreeing on marketing actions with marketing and business management.
  + Monitor competitor activities and provide actionable market intelligence to regional and global leadership.

* Customer and Partner Management including
  + Establish and maintain strong relationships with key customers, decision-makers, EPCs, consultants, OEMs, and strategic partners and integrators.
  + Actively participate in customer activities including meeting with existing and potential customers and channel partners, follow-up of opportunities, guiding and reviewing prospects.
  + Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and long-term customer retention.
  + Lead negotiations for major commercial opportunities and strategic contracts.
  + Drive distributor and channel partner performance, capability development, and growth initiatives.

* Cross Functional Collaborations
  + Collaborate closely with Marketing, Service, Product Management, Human Resources, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver business results.
  + Act as the primary India representative within the APAC Industrial Measurements leadership team.
  + Support implementation of regional and global strategic initiatives within the Indian market.

* Financial & Operational Management
  + Own sales forecasting, business planning, and budget management for India.
  + Prepare, follow-up and report the progress of annual plan. This includes defining key activities, market estimates, competition analysis, staffing requirements and marketing & expense budget for the area. Monitor key performance indicators and implement corrective actions where necessary.
  + Ensure compliance with company policies, governance standards, and ethical business practices.
  + Competence management. Maintain and enhance team’s expertise and knowledge of company's offering and trade skills. Develop practices for both direct customer contact and channel management, supported by utilization of modern marketing tools.

* Channel Partner Development and Management which includes
  + Working with and managing channels to ensure performance targets are achieved.
  + Developing marketing campaigns jointly with distributors
  + Analyzing new markets and seeking out suitable distributor candidates.
  + Organizing regular distributor trainings to ensure product knowledge stays up to date.
  + Supporting channels on opportunities by providing timely response to technical queries
  + Joint customer visits with distributors.

**6 months:**

* Strong familiarity with Vaisala’s Industrial Measurement’s offering
* Successfully built working relationships with our current channel partners.
* Successfully built working relationships with our key integrator and OEM customers.
* Evaluate and present a detail country strategy and plan to achieve to the target
* Identified key focus areas for Indian market
  

**12-24****months:**

* Within first 12 months, evaluate and present a detail country strategy and plan to achieve the targets set up under the India Business Plan.
* Strong market knowledge with networks across key focus industries of Semiconductors, Lithium Ion Battery, Data Centers, Life Sciences and Power. This could mean networking with end users, EPCs, PMCs and relevant integrators.
* Clarity on channel partner network and successful establishment of the partner network in each state.
  

**How is the selected person's performance assessed?**

Performance evaluation:

* Orders intake and revenue growth
* Gross margin and profitability
* Forecast accuracy
* Pipeline coverage and conversion rates
* Strategic account growth
* Customer satisfaction/NPS
* Market share development
* Team engagement and capability growth
* Distributor performance and channel growth
  

**Qualifications of the ideal candidate**

* You are an ideal candidate for this role if you have strong experience in leading high performing product/system team(s) in Vaisala. Managing an office requires a solid hands on attitude as well as excellent collaboration and problem solving skills. When leading a team and working within a global matrix organization it´s vital to have excellent people leadership, strategic thinking, solid planning and execution skills as well as great communication and negotiation skills.
* We value a person that is dynamic, active and inspires teams to work towards common goals.
* You also have solid understanding of modern IT tools, channel development and digital marketing. As a person you have a continuous development mindset as well as genuine drive to develop business, people and organisation and desire to make success within Vaisala
* Curiosity and a growth mindset to explore, learn, and apply AI tools in your daily work. We expect everyone at Vaisala to actively discover how AI can enhance their work
  

**Education**

An academic degree preferably a Masters level degree in industrial technologies or business management.

  

**Work experience**

Preferably 10 years of relevant experience in a relevant leadership role

  

**Language skills**

You have great communication and presentation skills in English.

The role combines relationship management, customer success, commercial coordination, opportunity identification, and sales enablement. The incumbent will work closely with the VP – Sales and cross-functional teams to strengthen customer engagement, protect recurring business, and create a qualified growth pipeline.

**Mandatory Requirement:**

* 3+ years of experience in Key Account Management, Client Relationship Management, Customer Success, or B2B technology sales.
* Experience managing international B2B customers; exposure to ERP, enterprise applications, SaaS, IT services, or software products is strongly preferred.

Work Dynamics

Creates Occupant Delight
  
Has a natural hospitality-orientated communications acumen
  
Embedded “Go To” trusted Workspace partner fostering all-level relationships

Deep Workspace & Surrounding area knowledge

Single Point of Contact for issues resolution & Workspace change within the premises

Establish direct relationship with the client business units and their neighbourhood community, understand their issues, display confidence and satisfy needs and requirements of all requests
  
Escalate facilities issues to management team when necessary
  
Consolidate feedback to management team regularly for ongoing improvement implementation
  
Participate in ad-hoc projects when required
