title: Data Center Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  

  

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.  

  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.  

Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large\-scale high\-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:  

  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

  

A day in the life  

As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day\-to\-day work will include:  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket\-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift\-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences
  

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  

  

Why AWS
  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

Work/Life Balance
  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  

Inclusive Team Culture
  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship and Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
* Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health \& safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Director Product Management – Technical , AI transformation
description:

**Title and Summary**


Director Product Management – Technical , AI transformation
Director Product Management – Technical – AI Transformation  

Overview  

Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  

  

The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Services is critical for the sustained, long\-term growth of Mastercard.

The Services Business represents over a third of Mastercard revenues and is a key differentiator for Mastercard. Role

* 10\+ years of experience in Process Automation, Industrial Control Systems, or related engineering solutions.
* Minimum of 5 years of experience in estimating, proposal management, bid execution, or commercial engineering roles.
* Proven experience successfully delivering complete proposals for large and complex projects, including international opportunities.

**Technical Competencies**
--------------------------

* Strong understanding of process industries, including Oil \& Gas, Refining, Petrochemicals, LNG, Power, Mining, Metals, and Minerals.
* Demonstrated technical expertise in Industrial Control Systems, including DCS, SCADA, PLC, and Safety Instrumented Systems (SIS).
* Experience with Honeywell automation solutions, including Experion, Safety Manager, FSC, and related technologies, is highly desirable.

**Leadership and Commercial Skills**
------------------------------------

* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams in a matrix organization.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including project costing, pricing strategy, margin analysis, and risk assessment.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, negotiation, and decision\-making skills.
* Strong technical and integrative thinking skills, with the ability to develop innovative, customer\-focused solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage stakeholders at all organizational levels.

**We Value**
------------

* Customer\-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering exceptional value and service.
* Strategic thinking and strong business acumen.
* Strong technical aptitude and systems\-thinking capability.
* Knowledge of Honeywell's automation portfolio and competitive industry solutions.
* Ability to drive results and perform effectively in a fast\-paced bid environment.
* Strong planning, organization, and prioritization skills.
* High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
* Ability to work independently with limited direction while effectively leading project teams.
* Continuous learning mindset and commitment to professional development.
* Mentoring and coaching capability to support team development.
* Strong presentation and communication skills.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related

  
Senior Estimator


**Position Summary**
--------------------

The Senior Estimator is responsible for leading the development, estimation, and delivery of high\-quality technical and commercial proposals for strategic Integrated Control \& Safety System (ICSS) projects. The role provides end\-to\-end ownership of the proposal process, including solution development, cost estimation, risk assessment, stakeholder coordination, vendor engagement, governance approvals, proposal submission, and post\-bid support.


Working closely with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Procurement, Finance, and external partners, the Senior Estimator develops competitive, compliant, and profitable solutions that maximize customer value while supporting Honeywell's strategic growth objectives. The role requires strong technical expertise, commercial acumen, leadership capability, and the ability to manage complex bid activities across multiple stakeholders and regions.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Proposal Leadership and Strategy**
------------------------------------

* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional proposal teams to develop accurate, compliant, and commercially competitive proposals within established timelines.
* Own the end\-to\-end proposal development process, from opportunity qualification through submission and post\-bid support.
* Participate in bid/no\-bid reviews and contribute to proposal strategy, risk mitigation, and win themes.
* Prepare and maintain comprehensive Proposal Execution Plans, including resource allocation, deliverables, responsibilities, milestones, and submission schedules.
* Lead the preparation and successful submission of large\-scale, complex proposals and tenders, including multi\-country and international projects.

**Technical Solution Development**
----------------------------------

* Analyze customer requirements, requests for quotation, specifications, and supporting documents to develop technically compliant and commercially viable solutions.
* Analyze, design, and develop end\-to\-end ICSS solutions, with a primary focus on Distributed Control Systems (DCS), SCADA, Process Safety Systems, PLCs, and associated automation technologies.
* Develop innovative technical and commercial alternatives that optimize competitiveness, profitability, risk profile, and customer value.
* Ensure proposed solutions align with customer requirements and Honeywell strategic initiatives, including market verticalization, new product introduction, and other growth priorities.

**Estimating and Commercial Management**
----------------------------------------

* Prepare accurate cost estimates and commercial proposals for greenfield, brownfield, modernization, and service projects using approved methodologies, tools, and procedures.
* Conduct commercial reviews to identify risks, opportunities, cost drivers, and margin improvement initiatives.
* Develop pricing strategies that balance market competitiveness, customer value, and business profitability objectives.
* Use applicable systems and tools to maintain accurate documentation of estimates, proposals, assumptions, exclusions, and supporting information.

**Vendor and Stakeholder Management**
-------------------------------------

* Coordinate with Procurement and supporting functions to obtain technical and commercial quotations from suppliers, subcontractors, and third\-party vendors.
* Establish and maintain effective working relationships with Sales, Operations, Engineering, Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and customers to support proposal success.
* Collaborate with regional and global teams to develop optimized technical and commercial solutions.

**Proposal Governance and Compliance**
--------------------------------------

* Ensure complete and compliant responses to customer bid packages, including all required technical submissions, commercial documents, scope of supply, and supporting information.
* Prepare and submit required approval documentation in accordance with Honeywell governance requirements.
* Ensure proposals comply with customer specifications, company standards, contractual requirements, and applicable regulations.

**Post\-Bid Support and Continuous Improvement**
------------------------------------------------

* Support customer technical and commercial clarification activities following proposal submission and update proposals as required.
* Continuously enhance knowledge of Honeywell solutions, industry trends, competitor offerings, and market developments.
* Drive standardization, process improvement, estimating best practices, and continuous improvement initiatives across the estimating community.
* Provide coaching, guidance, and mentoring to junior estimators and proposal engineers.

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Senior Manager, System Operation and Administrator
description:

title: Manager, Data Engineering
description:

The Global Analytics \& Insights (GAI) team is seeking a Data \& Analytics Engineering Manager to lead our team in designing, developing, and maintaining data pipelines and analytics infrastructure. As a Data \& Analytics Engineering Manager, you will play a pivotal role in empowering a team of engineers to build and enhance analytics applications and a modern data platform using Snowflake, dbt (Data Build Tool), Python, Terraform, and Airflow. title: Technical Account Manager
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

**Broadridge Trading \& Connectivity Solutions (BTCS)** is seeking a customer\-focused, technically capable professional to join our Customer Success team. This role is ideal for someone with 3–4 years of experience in the institutional brokerage ecosystem who understands Indian financial markets, trading workflows, and the technology that supports them.


As a **Customer Success Technical Account Manager**, you will serve as a strategic technical partner to clients using Broadridge trading platforms. You will help clients onboard successfully, adopt and optimise platform capabilities, overcome technical challenges, and realise sustained business value from their Broadridge solutions.

**Key** **Responsibilities**

* Build trusted, long\-term relationships with assigned clients and act as their primary technical advisor.
* Develop a strong understanding of each client’s business objectives, operating model, trading workflows, and technical environment.
* Drive adoption, optimisation, and value realisation across Broadridge solutions, identifying opportunities for broader usage and growth.
* Partner with Customer Success Managers and internal stakeholders to develop and execute account success plans aligned to client priorities.
* Identify, manage, and help remove technical barriers that may affect adoption, satisfaction, retention, or operational readiness.
* Advise clients on platform capabilities, integrations, upgrades, solution best practices, and effective usage.
* Monitor technical account health, proactively identifying risks, trends, service\-improvement opportunities, and areas for expansion.
* Lead regular technical account reviews covering platform performance, current initiatives, roadmap alignment, and recommendations.
* Coordinate with Product Delivery, Product Management, Engineering, and Support teams to ensure client requirements are understood and addressed effectively.
* Represent client needs internally by advocating for product enhancements, service improvements, and operational feedback.
* Support key customer lifecycle events, including onboarding, platform upgrades, change events, expansions, and readiness activities.
* Deliver training, enablement sessions, demonstrations, and knowledge\-sharing activities to improve user confidence and adoption.
* Build knowledge of Broadridge products and international financial\-market workflows, including principal and agency trading, equities, derivatives, and FX.

**Required Skills \& Experience**

* Minimum 3–4 years of relevant experience in the institutional brokerage ecosystem, including hands\-on support for trading applications.
* Good understanding of Indian financial markets, including NSE/BSE, the regulatory landscape, exchange trading, and the end\-to\-end trade lifecycle.
* Understanding of institutional order\-management workflows, including order entry, modification, cancellation, and execution.
* Familiarity with trading platforms, Order Management Systems (OMS), and/or Execution Management Systems (EMS).
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain technical issues clearly to both business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong problem\-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritise effectively in a fast\-paced, time\-sensitive trading environment.

**Preferred Skills \& Experience**

* Experience working with a stockbroker, institutional trading desk, trading technology provider, fintech, or capital\-markets firm.
* Exposure to Indian equities and derivatives markets.
* Familiarity with FIX connectivity and electronic trading workflows.
* Experience using AI and productivity tools to improve documentation, reporting, analysis, and routine operational tasks.


This role offers the opportunity to combine technical expertise, client relationship management, and capital\-markets knowledge to help clients achieve meaningful outcomes while building deep expertise in Broadridge’s trading and connectivity product suite.

title: Specialist Manager - OT Solution Integrator
description:
### **Job Summary**



Black \& Veatch allows you to lend your talent and perspective to humanity’s biggest challenges in a flexible environment where you are empowered to grow and explore new possibilities.



Our hybrid environment allows you to balance your work and personal life. At Black \& Veatch, you own your career with purpose and meaning. You are empowered to grow and explore new possibilities at every step of your career journey. Bring your big ideas while knowing you are safe to be who you are and speak up with concerns or questions and put your diverse talents and perspectives to use.



Black \& Veatch is seeking an exceptional and experienced professional to join our Infrastructure Advisory organization as a Manager – Consulting to provide expertise around OT Systems implementation and other related utility OT projects in an Integration Architecture capacity. The world is changing at an unprecedented rate and that change increases the demand for innovation and efficiency to deliver solutions and services across the world’s utility infrastructure. Join Black \& Veatch’s growing Infrastructure Advisory business and use your talents and expertise to deliver innovative solutions that drive measurable results for our clients, with the opportunity to grow your skills, expand your professional network, and shape a rewarding career path aligned with your aspirations.



The Delivery Team is a diverse group of early\-to\-mid career professionals with a solid foundation of utility experience and knowledge. Peers are engaged in a wide range of technical projects and encouraged to sharpen their skills to provide clients superior consulting services and continue to advance in a specialized career track. You will work with professionals in the Consulting and Digital Delivery Teams who represent a dynamic and cross\-functional group of experts in strategy, data, technology, and asset management systems. Together, they deliver innovative, data\-driven solutions that help clients navigate complex infrastructure challenges across diverse industries.



We partner with clients to align their people, processes, technologies, and data in response to rapid industry transformation. Our work enables organizations to modernize infrastructure, optimize asset performance, enhance resilience, and achieve long\-term sustainability goals. By joining this team, you’ll be part of a collaborative environment that values innovation, continuous improvement, and client success. You’ll contribute to mission\-critical projects that make a meaningful impact on communities and industries around the world.


### **Key Responsibilities**



The Solution Integrator is responsible for designing, orchestrating, and validating complex technology solutions across operational technology (OT) and enterprise IT environments. This role ensures that systems such as ADMS, EMS, SCADA, and associated platforms function cohesively as an integrated operational ecosystem. The Solution Integrator provides technical leadership across solution architecture, integration design, cybersecurity alignment, and end\-to\-end system validation within large\-scale utility transformation programs.


* **Solution Architecture \& Design**
* Develop and document end\-to\-end solution architecture across OT and IT systems, including ADMS, EMS, SCADA, GIS, and enterprise platforms
* Define logical and technical architectures, including system boundaries, data flows, and interface patterns
* Lead architecture workshops and design sessions to align stakeholders on solution approach
* **System Integration Design \& Oversight**
* Design and oversee integration architecture across multiple systems, vendors, and technologies
* Define integration patterns, interface specifications, and data exchange requirements across IT/OT boundaries
* Ensure interoperability and end\-to\-end functionality across integrated workflows
* **IT/OT Integration \& Operational Alignment**
* Lead the design and implementation of IT/OT integration strategies, ensuring alignment with operational workflows and control system requirements
* Coordinate across OT systems (ADMS, EMS, DERMS, SCADA) and enterprise IT systems (CIS, ERP, GIS)
* Ensure solutions support real\-time operations, reliability, and operational decision\-making
* **Cybersecurity \& Compliance Alignment**
* Integrate cybersecurity principles into solution and integration design, including access control, data protection, and secure communication patterns
* Align system architecture with enterprise cybersecurity policies, regulatory requirements, and industry standards
* Support risk identification, mitigation, and validation activities for OT and IT environments
* **System Validation, Testing \& Readiness Support**
* Support end\-to\-end system validation by ensuring integration design aligns with test scenarios and operational requirements
* Collaborate with testing teams to validate system behavior, data flows, and integration performance
* Participate in defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution of integration\-related issues
* **Integration Governance \& Vendor Coordination**
* Provide technical oversight and governance across vendors, internal teams, and system implementers
* Lead integration design reviews, ensure adherence to architecture standards, and manage technical risks
* Serve as the technical point of integration accountability across the project lifecycle


**Key Competencies**


* Systems thinking with the ability to connect complex technical components into a cohesive solution
* Strong stakeholder communication and facilitation across technical and business teams
* Ability to manage ambiguity and drive alignment across multiple vendors and workstreams
* Risk\-aware mindset with focus on reliability, security, and operational performance


\#LI\-PG1


### **Management Responsibilities**



Individual Contributor


### **Preferred Qualifications**


* Master’s degree in instrumentation, Information Technology or Engineering
* 10 years of experience in business and technology consulting, relevant product management, and/or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system integration and solution architecture
* 2\+ years of experience with electric utility control systems operations or maintenance
* Actively participated in at least two ADMS projects through the complete lifecycle including requirements development, design, systems integration \& implementation and testing
* Knowledge of industry standards (e.g., NERC CIP, IEC, IEEE) and utility regulatory environments
* Experience with integration platforms (e.g., MuleSoft, Boomi) and enterprise architecture frameworks
* Background in electrical engineering, computer engineering, or related technical discipline
* Knowledge of or direct experience with Grid Management \& Modernization Solutions Deployment (e.g. Grid Modernization Technologies, Advanced Distribution Management System, Distributed Energy Resource Management System, Automated Metering Infrastructure) and/or Utility IT Transformation (Enterprise Asset Management, Work Management, Customer Information Systems, ERP)

### **Minimum Qualifications**


* Bachelor’s degree in electrical, instrumentation or computer engineering, Information Systems, or similar Technical domain
* 7 years of experience in business and technology consulting, relevant product management, and/or project implementation services as part of an OT vendor team with emphasis on system integration and solution architecture
* Extensive Knowledge of Electric utilities operations functions and associated processes
* Actively participated in at least two ADMS projects with technical domain experience

description:

Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

The Cranial \& Spinal Technologies (CST) Operating Unit develops and delivers an integrated ecosystem of spinal implants, navigation and robotic guidance systems, advanced imaging, and data\-driven planning tools that support complex spine and cranial procedures. The Surgical Synergy portfolio combines enabling technologies and implants to help clinicians improve surgical workflow, procedural precision, and patient care.


This role is responsible for leading commercial activities across Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Goa, Gujarat, and Chhattisgarh. The position is field\-based and requires regular travel throughout the assigned territory to support customer engagement, business growth, team leadership, and market development initiatives.


This people leadership role is responsible for driving sales performance and market development for the Surgical Synergy (Spine) portfolio across a multi\-state territory. The individual will lead and develop a team of sales professionals, build strategic customer relationships, expand market adoption of the portfolio, and execute commercial strategies that support sustainable business growth.


**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**

* Build and maintain relationships with key healthcare stakeholders, decision\-makers, and customer accounts.
* Identify, develop, and convert new business opportunities while expanding existing customer partnerships.
* Partner with application specialists and cross\-functional teams to support customer education, clinical adoption, and commercial execution.
* Monitor market dynamics, competitive activity, and customer needs to inform business planning and territory strategy.
* Manage inventory, consignments, loaner assets, forecasting, and reporting activities in accordance with company requirements.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, ethical standards, and Sales Force Effectiveness (SFE) practices.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* High School Diploma (or equivalent) and 9\+ years of relevant sales, clinical, or related experience in medical devices, medtech, healthcare, or life sciences; OR Associate’s Degree and 7\+ years of relevant experience; OR Bachelor’s Degree and 5\+ years of relevant experience.
* Experience leading and managing a sales team, including supervision and development of experienced sales professionals and/or first\-line supervisors.
* Experience selling capital equipment, medical devices, or clinically focused solutions within a healthcare environment.
* Experience developing and executing territory or regional business plans to achieve commercial objectives.
* Ability to travel regularly throughout Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh, Goa, Gujarat, and Chhattisgarh.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience within Spine, Orthopedics, Neurosurgery, Trauma, or Operating Room (O.R.) environments.
* Demonstrated success selling concept\-based therapies, enabling technologies, or complex healthcare solutions.

title: Key Account Manager II View Jobs
description:
**Way of working \- Office/Field : Employees will work full time from their office base location**

 **About Swiggy:**


Swiggy is India’s leading on\-demand delivery platform with a tech\-first approach to logistics and a solution\-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500\+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh\+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on\-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning\-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.

**Overview**
------------


A Key Account Manager owns high\-value restaurant partners within an assigned city, typically chains, established multi\-outlet restaurants, and growing independents expanding to multiple locations. These accounts are more complex: they involve negotiations with multiple stakeholders, larger deal sizes, custom solutions, and deeper engagement around ROI and strategy. You combine field presence with office\-based analysis and executive relationship management. Success requires both relationship skills and the analytical ability to build customized business cases. You mentor the Sales Manager tier and own a portion of the city\-wide targets.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* Own a portfolio of multi\-outlet restaurants: Manage 30\-40 high\-value accounts(60 to 80 in case of Indianext cities), each with 2\-10 outlets. These accounts represent 40\-60% of city revenue
* Executive relationship management: Build relationships with franchise owners, regional managers, and operational heads. You are often dealing with decision\-makers, not individual restaurant managers
* Consultative strategy: Move beyond product features. Help restaurants think about their growth strategy across, e.g., optimizing delivery times, increasing order frequency, and cross\-location consistency
* Field presence with data: Conduct monthly visits to key accounts to understand operations, gather feedback, troubleshoot adoption barriers, and surface new opportunities
* Advanced analytics: Build detailed business reviews (QBR) for accounts. Analyze their performance across cuisine, compare against benchmarks, and present growth strategies
* Pipeline development: Identify expansion opportunities with existing accounts (new locations, new products/cuisine). Turn your relationship into revenue growth
* Excel excellence: Build executive presentations, ROI models for pitches, and monthly and quarterly business reviews with charts and trend analysis. Your spreadsheets must be presentation\-ready for C\-level stakeholders
* 60 to 70 in\-person restaurant partner meetings in a month

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

 **Experience \& Background:**

* 2\-4 years in account management, B2B sales, or enterprise sales (proven progression from SDR/AE to AE or AM role)
* Track record in managing multi\-stakeholder deals
* Restaurant Business is a round\-the\-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partner
* Advanced Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUP, data visualization, forecasting. You should be able to build a dashboard for each RP, which can help you and the restaurant partner to keep track of their business with us
* MBAs/PGDMs would be preferred in any discipline
* Strong Industry Understanding: Since this is a mid\-senior account management role, working knowledge of the restaurant ecosystem (unit economics, delivery margins, competitive landscape, aggregator dynamics) should be expected. Industry familiarity will significantly reduce ramp\-up time and improve consultative quality.

title: Curated Workplace Executive
description:
JLL supports the Whole You, personally and professionally.
  
  

Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology to our clients. We are committed to hiring the best, most talented people in our industry; and we support them through professional growth, flexibility, and personalized benefits to manage life in and outside of work. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades, and technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, we empower you to shape a brighter way forward so you can thrive professionally and personally.
  
  

Job Description \- Curated Experience (Executive)
  
Role Summary
  
The Curated Experience Executive shall work closely in co\-ordination with the Curated Experience Sr. Executive ensuring visibility and presence on a day\-to\-day requirement \& ensure organization associates and visitors are welcomed, valued, and taken care of at every stage while they are in the office.
  
  

Key Responsibilities
  
Guest Experience
  
The Executive is the first face a colleague sees and the last impression a guest carries with them. This means expressing warmth and professionalism at reception or entry, greeting people with care, and creating an atmosphere where every individual feels that their presence matters. Beyond the greeting, the Executive takes ownership of the physical readiness of the workplace by conducting regular and thorough checks of meeting rooms, collaboration spaces, pantries, and common areas to ensure everything is clean, stocked, and ready for use before it is needed. Responding to ad\-hoc colleague requests is done promptly and with a helpful spirit, and feedback collected during daily interactions is documented accurately and shared with the Sr. Executive to drive meaningful resolutions.
  
  

Operational Support
  
The Executive plays an active role in keeping daily operations flowing smoothly. Service requests are logged, tracked, and followed through to full resolution, with timely status updates provided to colleagues along the way. Daily site inspections are conducted with a watchful eye, identifying maintenance issues, supply gaps, or safety concerns before they escalate. Routine matters are channeled to the Curated Experience Sr. Executive, while safety or security concerns are escalated directly and immediately to the Facility Manager / Security Team. Trackers, logs, and basic operational reports are maintained with accuracy and consistency.
  
  

Conference \& Event Support
  
Executive ensures every room is set up to the highest standard viz., equipment tested, AV confirmed, refreshments in place (where requested), and the space reset promptly after every meeting concludes. For workplace events, training sessions, and engagement activities, the Executive provides dedicated on\-ground support, working alongside the Sr. Executive to deliver a seamless experience for every attendee.
  
  

Colleague Engagement \& Onboarding
  
Executive shall play a central role in making new hires feel genuinely at home from day one. Leading the site orientation tours, introducing colleagues to amenities, explaining workplace policies, and setting a warm and welcoming tone are all core to this responsibility. All colleague enquiries, whether received in person, via email or through chat are acknowledged and responded to within one business day. Executive also takes an active approach to learning by shadowing the Curated Experience Sr. Executive across site functions, building both capability and confidence within the Workplace Services environment.
  
  

Feedback \& Continuous Improvement
  
Executive shall gather real\-time experience feedback from colleagues and stakeholders during daily interactions, tours, and events, and document it accurately using designated trackers. This feedback need to be shared promptly with the Sr. Executive for review and closure, and the Executive follows up on minor items to confirm resolution. Beyond reactive feedback, Executive proactively reviews the service patterns, whether supply shortages, AV readiness issues, or space concerns contributing meaningfully to a culture of continuous improvement that elevates the experience for everyone.
  
  

Transport \& Commute Support
  
Executive serves as a trusted first point of contact for routine transport and commute queries, helping colleagues (especially new hires) navigate shuttle schedules, parking allocations, and booking protocols with confidence and ease. Complex issues, complaints, or service disruptions are escalated promptly to the Sr. Executive or the Transport team, ensuring no colleague is left without a resolution.
  
  

Additional Workplace Responsibilities
  
Executive supports visitor badging, temporary access requests, and compliance with site security protocols, ensuring access is managed seamlessly and in accordance with established guidelines. Workplace policies including clean desk standards, appropriate use of shared spaces, and visitor management are reinforced in a friendly, hospitality first manner that reflects the values of the Curated Experience team. Contractors and vendors on site are supported with basic orientation and access to amenities, ensuring their presence is well\-integrated and non\-disruptive. Throughout all of this, Executive remains observant and proactive, flagging risks, hazards, or service concerns to the Sr. Executive or Facility Manager without delay.
  
  

Qualifications
  
  

**Education \& Experience:**  

A Bachelor's degree or equivalent qualification is preferred with Two to three years of experience in hospitality, customer service, front desk management, facilities coordination, or a closely related field. Candidates who bring a passion for people are strongly encouraged to apply, even if their background spans multiple industries.
  
  

**Skills \& Competencies:**  

The ideal candidate is warm, approachable, and genuinely service\-oriented, someone who takes pride in the details and finds satisfaction in making others feel cared for. Strong verbal and written communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, and composure to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment are essential. Cultural sensitivity, patience under pressure, and the ability to de\-escalate situations with grace are highly valued. A collaborative spirit, a strong willingness to learn and grow, and proficiency in the Microsoft Office including Teams, Outlook, Excel, and Word.
  
  

Working Hours
  
Flexibility to support early morning or late evening / night activities is required based on site needs, including shift\-based working arrangements where applicable.
  
  

Reporting Structure
  
The Curated Experience Executive reports directly to the Curated Experience Sr. Executive and works in close day\-to\-day collaboration with Facility Management teams across the site.
  
If this job description resonates with you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements below. We’re interested in getting to know you and what you bring to the table!
  
  

Personalized benefits that support personal well\-being and growth:
  
  

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health.
  
  

About JLL –
  
  

We’re JLL—a leading professional services and investment management firm specializing in real estate. We have operations in over 80 countries and a workforce of over 102,000 individuals around the world who help real estate owners, occupiers and investors achieve their business ambitions. As a global Fortune 500 company, we also have an inherent responsibility to drive sustainability and corporate social responsibility. That’s why we’re committed to our purpose to shape the future of real estate for a better world. We’re using the most advanced technology to create rewarding opportunities, amazing spaces and sustainable real estate solutions for our clients, our people, and our communities.
  
  

Our core values of teamwork, ethics and excellence are also fundamental to everything we do and we’re honored to be recognized with awards for our success by organizations both globally and locally.
  
  

Creating a diverse and inclusive culture where we all feel welcomed, valued and empowered to achieve our full potential is important to who we are today and where we’re headed in the future. And we know that unique backgrounds, experiences and perspectives help us think bigger, spark innovation and succeed together.
